noi_dung:
A 1 - MONKS

I - TRI Nghi

Great Master Tri Nghi's family name is Tran, from Duc An, from Tan Xuyen. The mother dreamed of five-colored fragrant smoke covering her body and became pregnant. At the time of his birth, the whole house was brightly lit. His eyes have double pupils. From a young age, when he was lying down, he always leaned on his side, and when he sat, he always crossed his legs and faced west. Growing up, whenever he met Buddha statues or Bodhisattva statues, he immediately paid homage, and when he met the Monk, he immediately respected them.

At the age of 18, he became a monk at Qua Nguyen Pagoda in Tuong Chau. He knew the Vinaya Pitaka, recited the Lotus Sutra, and liked to meditate.

A little while later, he went to Mount Dai To in Quang Chau to pay respects to Zen Master Hue Tu. As soon as the Zen master saw him, he immediately said: "When the Buddha was still alive, you and I attended the Lotus Festival. Because of that fate, you now came to me." The Zen master immediately taught him the subject "Dharma Flower Samadhi" and preached "The Four Peaceful and Blissful Practices". He then stayed on this mountain to practice the Dharma of Flower Samadhi. Just after three nights, when reciting the sentence "The true spirit advances the name of the true dharma to make offerings to the Tathagata" in the Medicine King Bodhisattva's Prayer, his body and mind suddenly became empty and calm and entered concentration, illuminating the Dharma Flower, clearly understanding the dharma signs, and was impressed by Zen Master Hue Tu.

In the year of Quang Dai of the Tran Dynasty, he came to Kim Lang at Ngoa Quan Pagoda to teach Zen practice. In the year of Dai Kien, he went to Thien Thai mountain in Lam Hai to build a hut to live in. Not long after, he returned to Kim Lang.

After the Tran Dynasty passed away, he went through Lo Son and the lands of Kinh Chau and Duong Chau.

In the year of Khai Hoang of the Sui Dynasty, he returned to Thien Thai.

Before and after he built 36 pagodas and cast eighty thousand (800,000) bronze Buddha statues. He personally saved 14,000 monks. He bought more than 60 ditches, canals, lagoons, and rivers to make places to release animals. He presented a decree to the royal court prohibiting the catching of fish and birds... Indeed, everyone worshiped and respected Long Thien, and from then on the Phap Hoa sect became very popular. Tan Vuong received the Bodhisattva precepts from him, and then took the title of Tri Gia.

He has a collection of works called "Pure Land Ten Treatises", in the last chapter it talks about the two meanings of Happiness and Nightmare: If a person wants to be born in the Pure Land world, if they fulfill both of the following virtues, they will definitely be reborn.

A.- The practice of boredom leaves behind evil

B.- Hanh loves the Pure Land

A.- Ordinary people, from beginningless time until now, have been drawn by the five desires, so they have been reincarnated forever in the cycle of birth and death, suffering all kinds of hardships. If they do not become bored and separate from material desires, they will not be able to be liberated. So often observe that the human body is a bundle of blood, pus, saliva, and all kinds of stinking and dirty things. The Nirvana Sutra says: "This body is like that, like a stupid demon that always lives in it. Who is a wise person who likes it...". The sutras say: "This body is the meeting place of all miseries, the whole thing is dirty and rotten, the root of harm. Even the bodies of the Gods are the same."

People who practice practice, day and night, often observe that the body is miserable, dirty, not at all happy, not a bit clean, and the heart is very disgusting. If a person is in a place where lust has not been completely cut off, he must contemplate these seven ways:

1.- Consider that this body of lust is born from delusion and desire, it is a filthy seed.

2.- Due to the union of father's sperm and mother's blood, it is a filthy life.

3.- Many months in a woman's womb, which is a filthy abode.

4.- While in the womb, you only eat your mother's blood, which is eating unclean food.

5.- When a woman comes out from the woman's door after a full day, that is the filthy time of birth.

6.- Look closely at this body, under the thin layer of skin there are blood, pus and dirty things everywhere, it is the whole filth.

7.- After death, this body will rot and stink, which is ultimately filthy.

Considering that my own body is extremely filthy, I think that other people's bodies are also like that. If you can often have such dirty thoughts as above, your lustful thoughts will gradually weaken. And I should make a vow: May I quickly escape this dirty body of blood and pus in this miserable cycle of birth and death, and gain a pure and happy diamond body in the Pure Land.

B.- The happiness of desiring the Pure Land has two things:

I.- The meaning of praying for rebirth: People seek rebirth in the Pure Land precisely to save all sentient beings. Consider yourself like this: "I currently have no moral freedom. If I were in this corrupt and evil realm, the pollution would be too strong, I would have to be bound by karma and rotate in the six paths of reincarnation for many lifetimes and many lifetimes like the past. I would know when to escape and how to save sentient beings! Therefore, I pray to be reborn in the Pure Land to be close to the Buddha. After realizing the Dharma of Endlessness, I will then enter the corrupt and evil realm to save all living beings." Vang Sanh Luan says: "The person who develops Bodhi mind is the mind that wants to become a Buddha, the mind that wants to become Buddha is the mind that wants to save sentient beings, the mind that wants to save sentient beings is the mind that wishes to take living beings to the Buddha realm...". Where does this Bodhi mind come from? It is necessary to be born in the Pure Land, to be close to the Buddha, to quickly attain the patience of non-birth and then enter the world of birth and death to save sentient beings, to have enough wisdom and compassion, to be free and without hindrances, that is the Bodhi mind.

II.- Cultivation of pure karma: People who have a desire to return to the Pure Land should remember the physical appearance of Amitabha Buddha: 84,000 good appearances, each good appearance has 84,000 good forms, each good form releases 84,000 rays of light to shine throughout the Dharma world, capturing sentient beings reciting the Buddha's name. Observe the pure and dignified Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss as in the Contemplation Sutra, Infinite Life Sutra, etc. You should often practice "Buddha Recitation Samadhi" and practice good things such as: worshiping Buddha, chanting sutras, making offerings, repenting, maintaining precepts, giving alms, releasing living beings, etc., always dedicating them to pray to be reborn in the Pure Land. If so, then decide to be reborn...

The opportunity to teach was fulfilled, the Great Master went to Thach Thanh Pagoda in Viem Dong and told his disciples: "I will leave this world at this pagoda!". He told him to make his bed facing the West and then concentrate on reciting Amitabha Buddha, Prajnaparamita and Avalokiteshvara. He again told his attendants to light incense and lamps, and he loudly recited the Infinite Life Sutra and the Infinite Life Contemplation Sutra. After reciting the Sutra, he praised: "Forty-eight vows to adorn the Pure Land, the treasured lotus pond is easy to come by but no one is there. Evil people, the appearance of hell has appeared, repenting and reciting the Buddha's name can still be reborn, not to mention those who practice the Holy Virtue with the precepts, surely their efforts will not be in vain." The disciples replied: "I don't know what level the Great Master has attained? Where will he be reborn after leaving this body?". He replied: "If I am not busy with public affairs, I will definitely attain the level of "pure six senses". Because it will harm myself and benefit others, I will only get the "five-level" level. My teachers and friends will follow Avalokiteshvara and Mahasthamaprapta together to welcome me." Having finished speaking, the Great Master sat cross-legged and passed away, peacefully as if entering meditation. Life expectancy is 67 years old. It was November 24, the 17th year of Khai Hoang, Sui Dynasty.

Mr. Thich Hue Dien at Thien Huong Pagoda heard the news that the Great Master had passed away and was very sad. He wanted to know where the Great Master was, so he made a vow to describe the Lotus Sutra to seek enlightenment. At night, Mr. Dien dreamed of seeing Great Master Tri Jia sitting on a precious lotus throne following Avalokiteśvara, flying from the West, looking at him and saying: "Have you overcome your doubts yet?".

In addition, the Great Master shows many premonitions similar to the above.

Excerpted from the series: The Story of Cao Tang

Buddha's Universal Records, Pure Land Ten Treatises

ADDITIONAL WORDS.- Great Master Tri Jia, the First Patriarch of the Phap Hoa Sect, the one who taught only "one mind, three contemplations, one mindfulness, ten thousand actions". The Great Master personally realized the Dharma Flower Samadhi, propagated the Dharma Flower sect, took the Pure Land as his refuge, and the Great Master himself was reborn in the Pure Land. Therefore, the nobles in the Phap Hoa sect follow the Great Master's example, extremely propagate the Pure Land, and encourage all sentient beings to practice reciting the Buddha's name and be born together in the Pure Land.

---o0o---

II - TAIWAN

Dharma Master Tan Loan, from Nhan Mon, when he was young, he visited Ngu Dai mountain, saw many strange scenes, gained confidence and became a monk. Reading the Great Collection of Sutras, he saw that the words and ideas were both profound, so he took the trouble to comment. Just half a year old, he became seriously ill and needed all the medicine to be cured. He lamented to himself: "Human life is fragile and dies in the morning and evening! I heard that Immortals of eternal life often exist in the world. Before practicing the art of eternal life, after practicing Buddhism, you can do the same!". He went to Giang Nam to pray for immortality from Mr. Dao An Cu, a traditional immortal monk. Mr. Dao passed on ten volumes of the Immortal Sutra, and he happily brought it back, thinking that the Immortal Sutra could come true. Arriving in Luoyang, he met Tripitaka Dharma Master Bodhi Liuzhi, and he asked: "In Buddhism, is there a method of immortality better than this Immortal Sutra?". Dharma Tripitaka replied: "In this land, there is no dharma of immortality! Even though Tu Immortals can live long, they still have to reincarnate, which is not precious enough. Regarding immortality, we only have the Dharma of Buddhism!". The Dharma Master gave him the Quan Sutra book and said: "If you study according to this, you will no longer be reborn in the cycle of birth and death, all disasters and blessings will not be affected. When it comes to longevity, countless eons cannot compare. This is the ultimate method of eternal life of our Buddha!". Mr. Dam Loan was very happy, so he burned the Immortal Sutras and specialized in cultivating pure karma. He brought a very large place for self-cultivation and teaching to everyone. He composed 12 verses for the Pure Land ceremony following the verses of Nagarjuna Bodhisattva. He authored the collection "An Lac Tap" in 2 volumes, passed down throughout his life. The king of the Wei Dynasty respected him very much, took the title of "Dharma Master Than Luan", and invited him to be the abbot of Dai Tu Pagoda in Tinh Chau. Later, he passed through Huyen Trung pagoda in Van Chau.

In the 4th year of Hoa Hung, one night, a Saint Monk appeared to him and said: "I am Nagarjuna. I have been back to the Pure Land for a long time. Because of you, my comrade, I came to visit."

He knew in advance the time of his passing, so he gathered the assembly together and said: "The hardship of life and death knows when it will end. The sufferings of the three disciples must know how to fear, the nine levels of Pure karma must strive to cultivate diligently!". Then he told his disciples to chant Buddha's name loudly, and he turned his face to the West, bowed his head, and passed away. At that time, all the people at the pagoda saw the phan phan and said it was flying from the West, and the whole sky echoed with melodious music that took a long time to stop.

The court was informed and ordered to build a stele tower in Van Co (Son Tay).

Excerpted from the series: The Story of Cao Tang

Lac Ban Van Loai

ADDITIONAL WORD.- Heavenly Immortals live for a long time, so they are temporarily called immortal, also called immortal, because they are still ordinary people in the cycle of birth and death in the three worlds. Besides, Immortal practitioners are very obstructive to the path of liberation. Because the origin of samsara is in "self-clinging", self-clinging comes from loving the body, so the path of liberation begins with the concept of body-clinging, only by having body-clinging will there be no ego-clinging, no self-clinging will be enough to escape samsara. Because of this, Buddhism places a lot of emphasis on the following issues: contemplation of the filthy body, the root of suffering, impermanence, and lack of self... Immortal practitioners, on the contrary, love the body very much, so their cultivation methods are essentially to keep this body of flesh and blood for eternity. Loving the body is self-attachment and egoism, which is solidifying the root of samsara.

Dharma Master Than Loan heard a teaching and immediately burned the sutras and concentrated on practicing Buddhism. Is it because of his base greed, or was it because of his right wisdom?

---o0o---

III - SCRATCHING DAO

Zen master Dao Xuoc, surnamed Ve, from Tinh Chau, at the age of 14, he left home to study Sutras. He studied Zen with Master Toan Zen. Later, he became the abbot of Huyen Trung Pagoda in Van Thuy, the temple of Dharma Master Dam Loan. He admired the Pure Land conduct of Dharma Master Dam Loan, so he specialized in cultivating Pure Karma: sitting often facing the West, bowing to Buddha six times, never leaving the Pure Land, reciting Buddha's name seventy thousand times day and night.

There was a monk who entered the Pure Land trance and saw Zen Master Dao Xuoc sitting with a rosary in his hand, his huge body radiating light like a golden mountain. In addition, there are many other dialogues that cannot be counted.

He taught the Contemplation Sutra and the Infinite Life Sutra for nearly 200 times. The audience included both monks and laity, all holding strings in their hands and reciting Buddha's name like the sound of ocean waves. Every time after preaching the Sutra, when dispersing, the sound of Buddha's name resounds throughout the forest and the entire street.

He had two volumes of the Pure Land Treatise of Pure Land, whose words and meanings were essential, and people at that time held it in high esteem.

In the 2nd year of Trinh Quan of the Tang Dynasty, in the middle of preaching Sutras, they all saw Dharma Master Dam Loan sitting on a seven-jeweled throne calling Zen Master Dao Xuoc and saying: "Your precious temple in Pure Land has been completed, only the remaining body is not yet satisfied!". At the same time, everyone saw the Buddha sitting in the sky, heavenly flowers pouring down. They all admired and praised him.

From that day on, the Zen Master's propaganda became even more exciting. Sangha and laymen in the four directions come to respect each day more and more. At the age of 82, he passed away.

At that time, Venerable Thich Dao Phu, a close friend of the Zen Master, heard that the Zen Master had passed away, so he told everyone: "I usually promised to return to the Pure Land before you, but I didn't expect that now I will be late. I just took another breath to catch up with you." Having finished speaking, the Venerable immediately put on his robes, went to the Buddha statue to pay respects, then sat down respectfully and passed away.

Excerpted from the series: The Story of Cao Tang

Buddhist Patriarch Ky

---o0o---

IV - TANG HUYEN

Venerable Tang Huyen, a native of Tinh Chau, the Venerable is deeply versed in Zen Buddhism, has complete knowledge of the teachings, understanding, and conduct. At the age of 96, when he saw Zen Master Dao Xuoc preaching the Quan Sutra and the Pure Land Luan, the Venerable regained his mind and focused on reciting Buddha's name. Afraid that he was too old and wouldn't have much longer to live, the Venerable practiced Pure Karma very diligently: every day he bowed to Buddha one thousand times, recited Buddha's name ninety thousand times, and did so for a full 5 years without missing a single day.

One day, slightly ill, the Venerable gathered his disciples and said: "Amitabha Buddha gave me a beautiful fragrant robe, Avalokiteśvara and Mahasthamaprapta and the Holy Order all stood before me, countless Buddhas filled the entire space. Everyone stay and strive to practice. I will go!". Having finished speaking, the Venerable immediately passed away. The strange, sweet fragrance lasted seven days without dissipating.

At that time, Dharma Master Khai Phuong and Dharma Master Vien Qua watched the Venerable's rebirth. The two of them simultaneously aspired to be born in the Pure Land. Together, they went to Ngo Chon Pagoda to meditate for three months, dedicated to reciting Amitabha Buddha. The two Dharma Masters broke off a fresh poplar branch, placed it in the hands of the statue of Avalokiteshvara, and prayed in unison: "If we will be reborn in the Pure Land, may this poplar branch not wither." After seven days, that poplar branch became even greener. The two Dharma Masters were very happy and recited Buddha's name non-stop day and night. Five months later, one day while meditating, the two Dharma Masters found themselves at the treasure pond and saw Avalokiteshvara and Mahasthamaprapta sitting on two large, beautiful lotus flowers. Next, I saw Amitabha coming from the West and sitting on the largest lotus flower, the Buddha's body radiating bright light. The two Dharma Masters bowed to the Buddha and said: "The sentient beings in Saha recite the Buddha's name according to the teachings in the Sutra. I wonder if they will be born here?" Buddha taught: "Don't doubt! Decide to be born in my land." The two Dharma Masters heard the voices of Shakyamuni Buddha and Manjushri Bodhisattva praising the Lotus Sutra. On the treasure platform, I saw a large number of people, saying they were people in Saha who recited Buddha's name and were born like that.

After coming out of samadhi, Khai Phuong and Vien Qua two Dharma Masters told their disciples.

Excerpted from the series: Story of Song Cao Tang

---o0o---

V - KARACUU

Monk Kha Cuu is from Minh Chau and specializes in reciting the Lotus Sutra to seek rebirth in Ultimate Bliss. People at that time called him Cuu Phap Hoa.

In the year Nguyen Huu of the Song Dynasty, the Master passed away at the age of 81. Three days later, the Master came back to life and told him: "I came to the Pure Land to see a solemn and pure realm just as described in the Sutras. People here cultivate pure karma on flower platforms that have already been named. I saw a golden platform named after Huan Cong in Quang Giao Academy in Chengdu, a golden platform named after Ton Thap Nhi Lang in Minh Chau (Mr. Ton Trung), a golden platform named Kha Cuu, a silver platform named Tu Dao Co in Minh Chau." Having finished speaking, the Master closed his eyes. Five years later, Tu Dao Co lost the strange scent that fragrantly scented the whole house. 12 years later, when Mr. Ton Trung was reborn, heavenly music came to welcome him. Master Kha Cuu's words are true.

Excerpted from the series Pure Land Literature

---o0o---

V B - TWO SA DI

In Van Chau, there were two novice monks who recited Buddha's name together for five years. One day the old man died, his consciousness went to the Pure Land to worship Buddha and said: "I still have a fellow practitioner, I don't know if he will be born here?". Buddha taught: "Previously, thanks to that little novice monk's advice to you, you were able to develop the mind to recite Buddha's name. Now you have returned to try to purify your karma further. Three years later, the two of you will come here together."

The older novice monk came back to life and told the story of meeting the Buddha to the younger novice monk and everyone. From then on, the two of them became more diligent in their meditation practice.

Three years later, both mediums saw the Buddha and the Holy Order coming from the West. All over the earth trembled, flowers flew from the sky. The two men were reborn at the same time.

Excerpted from the series Buddhist Records

ADDITIONAL WORD.- Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva said: "Thinking of Buddha, reciting Buddha's name, now and in the future, I decide to see Buddha." Bodhisattva Bodhisattva also once said: "If a person specializes in reciting the Buddha's name and has one mind, even now he will see the Buddha." Seeing Buddha and being taught by Buddha by two Dharma Masters and two novice monks is proof.

Always remember that the Buddha is the Buddha mind, seeing the Buddha is the Buddha scene. The Buddha realm appears depending on the Buddha mind. The mind and the environment are not two, the mind-only way of communication manifests itself. If you want to see the Buddha scene, you must come from the Buddha mind. If you want to become a Buddha mind, you must specialize in reciting Buddha's name.

---o0o---

VI - EMPOWERMENT

Empowerment by the Great Master of the Ngo family, from Lam Hai. Just three months after he was born, he proclaimed Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha the Three Jewels. At the age of seven, he became a monk at Nhiep Tinh pagoda.

In the year of Chi Duc of the Tran Dynasty, he received the Dharma of Zen Contemplation with Great Master Tri Gia at Tu Thien Pagoda. After practicing for a while, Great Master Tri Gia was able to accept it, and then followed him as an attendant. Whenever he heard any Dharma lecture, he was familiar with it all.

After Great Master Tri Jia passed away, he promoted the teachings of the Thien Thai sect and diligently practiced concentration and wisdom. Every time he sat down and recited the Sutra, heavenly flowers often flew to his side. One day, while he was preaching the Nirvana Sutra at Nhiep Tinh pagoda, bandits came and attempted to rob the pagoda. The temple door suddenly appeared with flags covering the ground and countless soldiers taller than staff. The robbers fled in terror.

In the 6th year of Trinh Quan, on the 7th day of the August month, there was a strange scent in his room. He called his disciples to come and said: "I am about to be reborn!". He suddenly stood up, clasped his hands in reverence as if a Buddha or Bodhisattva were coming, recited Namo Amitabha Buddha out loud three times, his face was cheerful, he got up on the bed, turned his face to the West and passed away. Life expectancy is 72 years old. The top of my head remains warm all day.

Excerpted from the series: The Tale of Cao Tang

Buddhist Patriarch Ky

---o0o---

VII - Dharma wisdom

Great Master Phap Tri, the same year he became a monk, went to every place where the Sutras were taught and discussed. Later, when he heard that the method of attaining Buddhahood was quickly extinguished, no other method surpassed the method of reciting the Buddha's name. He told people: "I saw that the Sutra said that committing one kila (small sin) would result in falling into hell for an intermediate kalpa, then I believed it. I also saw the Sutra say that reciting Amitabha Buddha's name with one heart can destroy eighty million kalpas of great sins, then I still did not believe it." There was a Ton Tuc who rebuked him and said: "You have a great wrong view, it's all Buddha's words, why don't you believe it!". That one statement washed away the Great Master's doubts. He went to the Tu Suat platform at Quoc Thanh Pagoda diligently chanting Buddha's name day and night, feeling Avalokiteśvara and Mahasthamaprapta, two Bodhisattvas incarnate. Another day, he felt the heavenly body of Avalokiteshvara and the precious vase of Mahasthamaprapta radiating light to his body.

One day, the Great Master said goodbye to the assembly: "I am about to be reborn in the Western world of Ultimate Bliss, what will you use to say goodbye to me?". The Sangha and the monks made an appointment three days later to meet at the temple to hold a vegetarian feast to welcome the Great Master. When the time comes, after eating, many people stay at the temple to wait and see. At midnight, the Great Master sat cross-legged on the bed chanting Buddha's name and peacefully passed away. At that time, a fluorescent light flashed from the West, illuminating hundreds of miles. The people on the boats parked on the river thought it was morning, but they didn't expect it was just after midnight. Because of that bright omen, everyone recognized that the Great Master had truly been reborn.

Excerpted from the series: Story of Song Cao Tang,

Lac Ban Van Loai

---o0o---

VIII - TRI DIEM

Tri Diem Shaman Chau surnamed Minh Sang, from Ngo District. At the age of eight, he became a monk and became a disciple of Dharma Master Cu at Thong Nguyen Pagoda. He went to study everywhere and widely spread the Sutras. After the Tran dynasty passed away, he returned to Ho Khuu to meditate for 30 years. After the war, I had to migrate again.

In the 7th year of Wu Duc, Tang Dynasty, the governor of Suzhou, Mr. Ly Shijia, took him to Ho Khuu. From now on, he specialized in cultivating pure karma. Every month, more than 500 people meet at the temple to recite Buddha's name, always for more than 10 years without error. In October, in the 8th year of Trinh Quan, he first saw a Holy Monk holding a shining jeweled vase come before him and say: "I am Infinite Light. Later in the Pure Land called Cong Duc Buu Vuong, that's me!". After the Saint Monk disappeared, he told the crowd: "Infinite Light is Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva, and Merit Precious King is his Buddha name in the future. The Pure Land destiny has been fulfilled, I will return to the West!". At night, he sat cross-legged and passed away at the age of 71.

Excerpted from the series : Buddhist Patriarch Ky

Ho Khuu Chi

---o0o---

IX - DANG QUAN

Zen Master Dang Quan's family name is Ton, from Phu Duong. He learned the mind contemplation method from Great Master Tri Jia, then in Thien Thai practiced meditation and often recited the Lotus Sutra. In the winter of Trinh Quan's 9th year, Phap Nhan Pagoda in Du Hang invited him to preach the Sutra. On the first day of January of the following year, someone wearing a king's uniform came to Bach Pagoda with him: "The disciple is the god of Kieu Dinh temple. Last month, the Master passed by the temple, when the disciple was busy on a tour, so he did not have the opportunity to welcome him. Today, the disciple came here to pray for the Dharma precepts." He then lit an incense burner and gave the Bodhisattva precepts to God. After receiving the precepts, the God gave thanks and retreated. After midnight, he showered, changed his clothes, sat cross-legged facing the West, loudly chanting the Three Saints of the West and the name of Great Master Tri Gia. A large crowd gathered around him and he clearly preached the Dharma of one mind and three meditations. After preaching, he still sat still in his seat and passed away.

Excerpted from the series Buddhist Records

---o0o---

X - GERMANY AMERICA

Master Duc My, surnamed Vuong, from Thanh Ha, became a monk at the age of 16, strictly maintained the precepts, diligently repented every day. He often chanted the Sutra “Ten Thousand Thousand Buddha Names”. In the year of Great Karma, he stayed at Hue Linh Pagoda in Kinh Su, organized good deeds, and received a lot of inspiration.

In the year of Vo Duc, he returned to Hoi Xuong Pagoda and established the Sam Hoi Hall in the west of the pagoda as a place to practice "The Eightfold Samadhi", not sitting for an entire summer.

There was a time when, to prevent his mouth from making mistakes, he did not speak for three years. At times, practicing the practice of Non-Contempt, he paid homage to all seven groups. He cut off all worldly affairs, focused on the Pure Land, and maintained the Buddha's name for the rest of his life without fail.

In December of the 11th year of Trinh Quan's reign, one day he invited the crowd to a gathering and instructed everyone to diligently recite Buddha's name and practice. Having finished his instructions, he clasped his hands and chanted the Buddha's name and passed away, at the age of 63.

Excerpted from the series Tuc Cao Tang Truyen

---o0o---

tom_tat: Nun Hue Moc, surnamed Pho, became a monk at the age of 11 at a temple in Tuong District. Every day she recited the Great Prajnaparamita Sutra, often seeing many strange phenomena. The nun once dreamed of going to the West, seeing in a treasured pond many beautiful bright lotus flowers...
noi_dung:
B 1 - MONKS

I - HUE MOC

Nun Hue Moc, surnamed Pho, became a monk at the age of 11 at a temple in Tuong District. Every day she chanted the Great Prajnaparamita Sutra, often seeing many strange phenomena. The nun once dreamed of going to the West, seeing in a treasured pond there were many beautiful, shining lotus flowers, and those who were reborn were all sitting on the flowers. A little while later, she invited the teacher to receive full ordination. While at the altar, she suddenly saw the sky and earth turn into a golden color.

One day, when she and the crowd worshiped Amitabha Buddha, she lay on the ground for a long time and did not wake up. The person standing nearby kicked her and asked. She replied: "While bowing and seeing myself in the world of Ultimate Bliss, the Buddha preached Prajnaparamita to me. As soon as I heard the four volumes, I was kicked and woke up. I'm so sorry!"

14th year of Yuanjia, Liu Song dynasty. Nun Hue Moc was reborn with many good omens and lived to be 69 years old.

Excerpted from the series Dharma Garden Chau Lam

---o0o---

II - Dharma Thanh

Nun Phap Thanh's family name is Nhiep, from Thanh Ha. At the age of 70, he became a monk at Kien Phuoc Pagoda in Kim Lang. She was naturally very intelligent, and once told her Dharma friends Dam Kinh and Dam Ai: "I established myself to practice religion, only determined to return to the Western world of Ultimate Bliss."

In the 16th year of Nguyen Gia, on September 27, the nun went to the stupa to worship Buddha. That afternoon she became sick. On the night of September 30, the entire temple, inside and out, suddenly lit up like daytime. The nun said: "It was Amitabha Buddha along with Avalokiteshvara and Mahasthamaprapta, so it was so bright..." After saying that, the nun was silent. They came closer to see, and it turned out she was gone. At the age of 72, she became a monk for only 2 years.

Excerpted from the series Bhikkhunī Stories

---o0o---

III - TINH CHON

Nun Tinh Chon from the Tang Dynasty, at Tich Thien Pagoda in Truong An, never left her body without leaving her robes, always begging for alms. During her lifetime, she recited the Diamond Sutra for 100,000 volumes. Every day she diligently recites Buddha's name. One day she told her disciples: "In the last five months, I have seen Buddha ten times, and twice I have seen Heaven playing on a precious lotus flower. I have been reborn as a High Rank." Having finished speaking, she sat cross-legged, clasped her hands and passed away. At that time, a beautiful cool light shone throughout the temple for a long time before it was hidden.

Excerpted from the series Buddhist Records

---o0o---

IV - Dharma Tang

Nun Phap Tang, from the Tang Dynasty, lived in Kim Lang, diligently chanting Buddha's name day and night. One night, seeing the light of Buddha and Bodhisattva illuminating the entire temple, the Nun clasped her hands and silently passed away.

Excerpted from the series Buddhist Records

---o0o---

tom_tat: At that time, the Buddha Shakyamuni lived in Niju Da forest in Kapila country. One day, the Master sent Ca Luu Da Di to educate his father, King Tinh Phan. Ca Luu Da Di immediately used his supernatural powers, sat cross-legged and flew...
noi_dung:
C 1 - BELIEVERS

I - SEVENTY THOUSAND PEOPLE THEY LIKE

At that time, the Buddha Shakyamuni lived in Niju Da forest in Kapila country. One day, the Master sent Ca Luu Da Di to educate his father, King Tinh Phan. Ca Luu Da Di immediately used his supernatural powers, sat cross-legged and flew in the air straight to Ca Ty La city, then preached the Buddha's merits to King Tinh Pham. The king felt a sense of faith and led people from the Thich family to the forest to worship Buddha.

The Buddha widely preached the meaning of “Three Doors of Liberation” to his father and the Sakyans. The Buddha taught again: "All dharmas are Buddha dharmas." The king commented: "If all dharmas are Buddha dharmas, then all sentient beings should also be Buddhas." The Buddha preached: "If you are in living beings without being confused and realize that they are "Buddha". Calling "Buddha" means seeing living beings as they really are. Realizing living beings as they really are means seeing "Reality". Reality is the "dharma realm". All dharmas are inherently unborn, this is the Da-lani door. You should pay attention to this unborn dharma, don't believe elsewhere!"

At that time, King Tinh Phan and seventy thousand people of the Thich family listened to the Buddha's teachings and all realized the Dharma of Endlessness. The Buddha smiled and said: "The person named Thich has wisdom and determination, so he can quickly and firmly abide in the Buddha Dharma. After completing this person's body, he will be reborn in the Pure Land world, so that he can be close to Amitabha Buddha and soon achieve Supreme Bodhi."

Excerpt from the Precious Stone Sutra

---o0o---

II - SAI MA KIET

In the city of Kapilavastu, there was a wealthy man, Sai Ma Kiet, who came to pay homage to the Buddha and said: "What conduct does a Bodhisattva practice to quickly attain Supreme Enlightenment, complete all good signs, etc.?". Because of him, the Buddha preached the acts of almsgiving, precepts, patience... and finally the Buddha concluded that there is no self, no cause, and is like an illusion. After listening to the Buddha's lecture, Mr. Sai Ma Kiet immediately attained the Dharma of Endlessness. In the Dharma assembly, 500 Bhikkhus, 500 Buddhist monks and 500 Buddhist nuns all witnessed non-regression. The Buddha prophesied that all of the above people would be reborn in the pure land of Amitayus Buddha in the West when they died. He would always protect and uphold countless Buddha Dharma, teach and transform countless people, making them all attain the state of non-regression. Practicing like this for countless eons later, in this world, one will become a Buddha in succession.

Excerpted from the Bodhisattva Earth Birth Sutra

---o0o---

III - O TRAN QUOC

King O Trannh loved Buddhism very much. One day the King told his officials: "Even though I am on the throne and enjoy blessings, I still cannot escape impermanence. Hearing that the Sutra says that the Western Land of Ultimate Bliss is a place of liberation, I must make a vow to pray to be born in that world!" From then on, day and night, six times, the king practiced reciting Buddha's name. Often when the Sangha's son, the king and queen personally offer food and water as offerings. The king diligently practiced like this for about thirty years. At the time of his death, the king's appearance was cheerful and showed many good omens.

Excerpted from Vang Sanh Tap

---o0o---

IV - EXPENDITURE FLOW

Mr. Luu Trinh Chi is from Trong Tu, from Peng Thanh. His father passed away early, he worshiped his mother very filially, studied the scriptures and history, and was very good at the doctrines of Laos and Trang. He served as a Military Officer in Pengcheng. Because he did not like to follow customs, even though the public officials repeatedly brought him to the court, he tried to resign.

At that time, Great Master Hue Vien was in Lo Son practicing the Samadhi of Buddha's name. He heard the sound and came to Lo Son to follow and practice. The great master asked: "Why did the great mandarin leave?". He said: "The Jin dynasty is not stable, there are many disasters for high-ranking officials, and there is impermanence and uncertainty, so I have to worry about life and death, so I give up worldly affairs and seek the Dharma!"

Liu Yu, a famous man at that time, gave Mr. Liu Trinh Chi the title Di Dan, to represent Mr. Chi's will.

At the same time, there were famous and virtuous scholars, such as gentlemen: Tong Xat, Loi Thu Tong, Chau Tuc Chi, Truong Da, Truong Thuyen, Tat Tan Chi, etc. and a large number of Venerable Cao Monks came to Lo Son. Master Hue Yuan led everyone to come before the statue of the Western Three Saints to make a vow to cultivate pure karma. That was the first Buddhist recitation meeting in the East.

Following the words of Great Master Hue Vien, Mr. Trinh Chi composed an oath to practice the Pure Land, to be born together in the Pure Land, to hope to become Buddha, and to save sentient beings while touching the stone stele.

Not long after, Mr. Trinh Chi went to the northern ravine of Tay Lam and built a private room as a place to meditate and recite the Buddha's name. After staying in the retreat for half a year, while meditating, he saw the light of Amitabha Buddha illuminating the ground into a golden color. Fifteen years later, while reciting Buddha's name, he saw Amitabha Buddha appear in his golden body, emitting light to shine on him. He immediately bowed and said: "I hope the World-Honored One will kindly pat my head and cover my body with his robe." Then he bowed his head at the Buddha's feet. Buddha immediately reached out his golden hand to pat his head and pulled the golden robe over his body.

A few days later, he dreamed that he came to a seven-jeweled pond. In the pond were countless large blue and white lotus flowers, and the water surface was as clear as lapis lazuli. A tall man, with a round halo of light on his head and a swastika on his chest, pointed at the pond water and told him, "The water of the bowl of merit is here, drink it!". He obediently took the water in his hand and drank it. It smelled delicious and refreshed his mind. After he woke up, a strange scent emanated from his pores endlessly. He told the story to his fellow practitioners and said: "I, my destiny to return to the Pure Land has come!". Then he invited the monks to recite the Lotus Sutra. And he burned incense to the Buddha and bowed, praying: "Thanks to the Buddha Shakyamuni, I have come to know Amitabha Buddha and the Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss. Therefore, I sincerely offer this incense first to the Buddha, then to the Buddha Amitabha Buddha, and then to the Lotus Sutra, because thanks to the merit of this Sutra, I will be reborn. I vow to be reborn in the Pure Land with all sentient beings." After praying and bowing, he said goodbye to everyone, then sat down on his bed, facing the West, and passed away at the age of 59. At that time, it was the year of Nghia Hy of the Jin Dynasty.

Excerpted from the series: The Tale of Dong Lam,

Exit Tripitaka Volume

---o0o---

V - DUONG KIET

Duong Kiet's name is Vo Vi Tu, from Thu Cong, he is from Vo Vi. In Nguyen Phong's year, he became mandarin Thai Thuong. Initially, he loved Zen, studied with Zen Master Thieu Y, and studied the teachings of the lay practitioner Bang. One day at Thai Son, when he saw the rising sun like a bronze tray rising up, he suddenly had a great enlightenment.

In the year of Hy Ninh, his mother passed away and he returned home to mourn. When Nhon was free from official duties, he specialized in reading Sutras, and for that reason he respected the Pure Land. He painted a statue of Amitabha Buddha and carried it with him wherever he went to worship day and night. During his life, he wrote a lot, all of his writings refer to the Pure Land. Below is the preface to the Pure Land Ten Nghi Treatises he composed.

"If love is not heavy, then it will not give birth to Saha, if mindfulness is not pure, then it will not give birth to Pure Land. Saha is a dirty place, Pure Land is a pure place. The life span of a Saha person is limited, but a Pure Land person lives an infinitely long time. In this Saha world, there are countless sufferings, that Pure Land only enjoys pure happiness. In Saha, living beings must follow their karma to be reincarnated into birth and death, and in Pure Land, once they are born, it will be over. To attain the No-birth Dharma and become a Buddha in one lifetime, if you want to save living beings, you can be free and free from karma, not being bound by karma and purity, suffering and happiness, old age and death and longevity, samsara and liberation, birth and death and freedom... The two realms are clearly different, but people don't know it, it's so sad.

Amitabha Buddha is a good father who takes sentient beings to the Pure Land. Shakyamuni Buddha is the bright teacher who shows the way to Ultimate Bliss. Avalokiteśvara and Theravada are two great Bodhisattvas who help Buddha save sentient beings. That's why in the Mahayana Sutras, there are always detailed instructions advising people to take the vow of rebirth.

Amitabha Buddha, Avalokitesvara, and Theravada sat on a boat, vowing to travel in the sea of ​​birth and death, neither anchoring on this shore, nor docking on the other shore, nor stopping in the middle of the stream, only taking charity as their duty. As the Amitabha Sutra says: "If any good man or woman hears Amitabha Buddha and then upholds the name from one day to seven days with one mind without disturbance. When that person dies, Amitabha Buddha and the Saints appear before that person. When that person dies, his mind is not crazy, and he will immediately be reborn in the Land of Ultimate Bliss..." The Infinite Life Sutra says: "Sentient beings in the ten directions hear my name, remember my realm, practice good deeds and dedicate their minds to it." I wish to be born in my realm. If that wish is not fulfilled, then I will not attain perfect enlightenment."

When the Master was in this world, the main monastery of Impermanence at Ky Hoan Tinh Monastery arranged for sick people to face the West, thinking exclusively of the Pure Land world to pray for rebirth... Because Amitabha Buddha's light shines throughout the dharma world, capturing all living beings while reciting the Buddha's name and never leaving them behind. Saints and mortals are one in the same, whenever there is a mind to recite Buddha's name, Buddha will come to receive them, that is a feeling of compatibility. All sentient beings in the Buddha's mind are all in Ultimate Bliss everywhere. The Pure Land in the minds of sentient beings is Amitabha. Based on the above reasons, I consider that: "A wise person can easily be reborn, because there is no such doubt. A meditative person can easily be reborn, because there is no confusion. A person who keeps the precepts can easily be reborn, because he is not polluted. A person who gives alms is easily reborn, because he is not attached. A patient person can easily be reborn, because he is not angry. An diligent person can easily be reborn, because he does not regress. A person who does not do good, does not cause evil, can easily be reborn, because he is diligent. Such a pure thought. Forgive the person who committed the crime, whose karma has already appeared, but still be reborn because of the utmost repentance and fear. You should know that even if you have many blessings, if you do not have confidence and do not make a dedication, you will not be reborn.

Oh ! Amitabha Buddha is very easy to recite, Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss is very easy to return to, but sentient beings do not want to recite and do not want to return, even though the Buddha is a great compassionate person, there is no way he can do it. Furthermore, anyone who commits a crime must fall into a miserable place, and if he recites Amitabha Buddha's name, he will be born in the Pure Land, both of which are the Buddha's words. People in this world are afraid of falling, but they doubt the possibility of rebirth. Isn't that very delusional?

In the year Nguyen Huu, Song Dynasty, he held the position of De Hinh Luong Triet. One day he gathered his relatives to say goodbye and said: "When living, there was nothing to be attached to, and when dying, there was nothing to throw away. All over the void: chi, lake, fake, wild. Mistakenly sent to the Western Pure Land!". With that said, he happily and peacefully passed away.

Previously, there was military officer Vuong Trhong Hoi, who once received the Buddhist recitation method from Mr. Kiet. Mr. Hoi once asked: "How can we recite Buddha's name without interruption?". Mr. Kiet replied: "Once you are convinced, there is no more doubt, that is uninterrupted." Mr. Hoi was very happy when he heard that teaching. The following year, Mr. Kiet dreamed that Mr. Hoi came to bow to him and said: "Thanks to you in the past, thanks to you teaching me the method of reciting Buddha's name, now I have been reborn in the Western Pure Land, so I have come to thank you." A few days later, Mr. Kiet received a funeral card and a letter from Mr. Hoi's son saying: "Mr. Trong Hoi knew the date and time of his death, said goodbye to his friends, and left in peace."

After Mr. Duong Kiet passed away, Kinh Vuong Phu Nhon, a virtuous monk who traveled to the West, saw a person sitting on a large lotus flower, wearing beautiful, flowing clothes, wearing a golden crown and a pearl necklace. Phu Nhan asked the person standing nearby and replied that he was Vo Vi Duong Kiet.

Excerpted from the series: Dong Do Su Luoc

Lac Ban Van Loai

---o0o---

VI - SWITCH DISABILITY

Mr. Khuyet Cong Tac was from the state of Zhao. During the Jin Dynasty, he lived in Luoyang, was calm and indifferent to worldly affairs. Every day he received and recited the Lotus Sutra.

After he passed away, his friend went to Bach Ma Pagoda to set up an altar to dedicate his merits to him. That night, while the crowd was chanting the Sutras, they heard someone calling in the void, and light shone down. Everyone went out to the yard and looked up at the field and saw a person with a very bright and beautiful body looking down and saying: "I am Khuc Cong Tac! I have been born in the Pure Land world and now I and the noble people have come to listen to the Sutra."

Mr. Ve Ve Do from Ham District was originally a student of Mr. Tac. Mr. Do's mother often visits Tang's son at home. One day, close to noon, the monks were about to eat food. In the middle of nowhere, a bowl suddenly fell in front of Mr. Do's mother. Everyone looked closely at the bowl that Mr. Cong Tac used to use in the past. That bowl was filled with rice, and the fragrant smell of rice filled the whole house. Those who ate that rice stayed healthy for seven days without feeling hungry. Mr. Chi Dao Lam, a famous person at that time, praised Mr. Tac: "Great is Mr. Khuyet Cong Tac! The sacred god! The god of Ultimate Bliss, in response to the Eastern Kinh. Flying in the sky with a bright body and a harmonious voice. I respectfully offer a few words, to be passed down in life."

Excerpted from the series: Dai Duong Noi Dien Luc

Reciting the Buddha's Samadhi and the King's Treatise

---o0o---

VII - RENEWAL

Mr. Canh Tan, surnamed Ngan Buu, from Tan Da, was well-versed in history. He has a simple personality, likes mountain and forest scenery, is a vegetarian, has rough and tattered clothes, and does not like doing business. He was naturally gentle and patient, diligent in practicing virtue.

King Luong Vo De was close to Mr. Tan when he was young. When he was honored, the king invited Mr. Tan to take the position of Binh Tay Phu Ky That, but Mr. Tan did not accept. In the year of Pho Thuong, Emperor Luong Vo again decreed the appointment of Huynh Mon Thi Lang, Mr. Tan said he was sick and resigned. After that, Mr. Tan set up an ashram at home, repented six times day and night, and recited the Lotus Sutra one set each day.

One night, a monk came to the ashram calling himself Nguyen Cong, called Mr. Tan Thuong Hanh, gave Mr. Tan a stick of incense and then disappeared.

In the 4th year of Dai Thong, Mr. Tan, who was sleeping during the day, suddenly woke up and called his family members, saying: "Nguyen Cong has come, we can't be late!". After saying that, he stopped breathing. The whole family heard a loud chant in the sky: "Sir Thuong Hanh has been born in the pure realm of Amitabha Buddha!". That year Mr. Tan was 78 years old.

Excerpted from the series Southern History

---o0o---

VIII - TON TRUNG

Mr. Ton Trung is from Minh Chau, was born in the West, is a vegetarian and keeps the precepts. He built a hut, dug two large ponds to plant white lotus, built a temple next to the pond, and a group of good believers established an assembly to recite Buddha's name.

One day he saw Amitabha Buddha appearing in the sky. He quickly ran to the yard and called his two sons to bow to the Buddha together on the ground. The Buddha appeared for a long time before hiding. That's why people at that time called that land Tru Phat hamlet (the land where Buddha stopped).

In the 8th year of Nguyen Huu of the Song Dynasty, Master Kha Cuu was born in the Western Pure Land. Three days later, he returned and said he saw on the golden platform the name Sun Thap Nhi Lang (ie Ton Trung).

Twelve years later, he fell ill and invited 100 monks and laity to recite Buddha's name. While the crowd was chanting, Mr. Ton Trung suddenly raised his face and looked up into the void, clasped his hands and bowed, then crossed the mudra and passed away. Everyone in Minh Chau city heard the sound of heavenly music and a strange scent drifting towards the West.

Mr. Trung's two sons were also diligent in reciting Buddha's name. A short time later, they sat facing the West and recited Buddha's name and passed away.

Excerpted from the series Buddhist Records

---o0o---

IX - DESCRIPTION OF THE BODY

Mr. Ta Than, from Lam Hai, received the Bodhisattva precepts from Divine Illumination Dharma Master. He heard the teachings of the Mahayana Dharma and suddenly became enlightened. From then on, he strictly maintained the precepts, created statues of the Western Three Saints, and worshiped early and late in the evening to pray for birth in the Pure Land. He recited the Sutra before and after counting 3,400 sets of Dharma flowers and 20,000 volumes of Vajra.

In the second year of Thieu Thanh, in the fall, he fell ill and told his son, the monk Tinh Vien, to propose the Lotus Sutra. Next he dreamed of three tall people standing on the riverbank calling for him to quickly get on the boat. He obeyed and the boat immediately sailed away to the West. Waking up, he knew it was time to be reborn, so he immediately invited the monks to his house to recite the Amitabha Sutra. He told everyone: "I have seen the Buddha's light." He took a bath himself, changed his clothes, and told his relatives not to cry and disturb his rebirth. Then he sat upright, crossed his arms and passed away.

Excerpted from the series: Phap Hoa Tri Nghiem Ky

Buddhist Patriarch Ky

---o0o---

X - VUONG DIEN

Mr. Vuong Dien, whose name is Vo Cong, is from Minh Chau. He failed the Tan Si department. He wore cloth clothes and became a vegetarian and went everywhere to study Buddhism. When he was old, he stayed at home and specialized in reciting Buddha's Samadhi. He narrated the book "Pure Land Self-Confidence", and below is the preface to that book:

"Buddha's Pure Land Dharma teaches, there is one word that covers the entire meaning: ordinary people can stay at the level of non-regression. Why is that? Because in this Saha practice, in the Mahayana Complete teachings in the time of first believing in Bodhisattvas, and in Hinayana in the first time of attaining the status of saints, these two levels have abandoned their views or begun to surrender to the saints, wrong views of the three poisons no longer arise, completely recovered from evil paths without losing their human bodies, heavens and ways of life without forgetting the attained results. As for the ordinary people, whether they are submissive or submissive people. Enlightened Bodhisattva, once he is born and died, often forgets the place of practice in the previous life, so some people encounter obstacles and have to renounce the path and fall into the three paths.

Why is it equal to the Pure Land, where there are only good people and no evil paths, so if we are reborn, we will completely escape the three paths. In addition, the support for practice is very complete, and the lifespan is limitless and boundless. Even if you are a very stupid person, within one lifetime you will definitely attain Sainthood, without any withdrawal. That's why the Buddha always praises the Pure Land and makes a vow to pray for rebirth. If you are a person of great intelligence and wisdom, you can see your nature and dedicate it to seek rebirth, then you will attain high rank. People from rural areas who diligently recite the Buddha's name and make earnest vows will be able to attain rebirth.

Oh ! If you look closely at a Buddha's name, you will clearly see that the Buddha's heart does not leave out anyone. Those who persist in ignorance and imitate the practice of no hindrance and no practice are embarrassing themselves but also embarrassing everyone, so pitiful and pitiful!

In the 16th year of Shaoxing, April, one night, a strange, sweet scent filled the house. Mr. Dien told monk Tu Te: "That is my pure karma." Then he washed, changed his clothes, sat down, faced the West and died. After burning his body, he received 108 relics the size of a grain of rice.

Excerpted from the series: Buddha's Reconciliation

Lac Ban Van Loai

---o0o---

tom_tat: Queen Mother Vi De Hi, from Ma Kiet country, wife of King Tan Ba ​​Ta La in the capital Wang Xa. Prince Ajatasatru listened to the words of monk Dieu Dat and arrested his father, Tan Ba ​​Ta La, and imprisoned him in a seven-door prison, strictly forbidding officials from...
noi_dung:
D 1 - FEMALE TRUSTEES

I - VI TOPIC HI

Queen Mother Vi De Hi, from Ma Kiet country, wife of King Tan Ba ​​Ta La in the capital Wang Xa. Prince Ajatasatru listened to the words of monk Dieu Dat and arrested his father, Tan Ba ​​Ta La, and imprisoned him in a seven-door prison, strictly forbidding mandarins from entering, intentionally leaving the king to starve to death. The new queen mother bathed thoroughly, took powder mixed with milk and honey and spread it on her body. She put grape juice in her pearl necklace, then went to visit the king and secretly offered it to him to use. Venerable Maha Maudgalyayana and Phu Lau Na used their magical powers to fly to give the Eight Precepts and preach the Dharma to the king. Every day he was able to eat milk powder and drink grape juice, and was ordained to listen to the Dharma, so even though he was imprisoned, the king's appearance became more healthy and happy.

Twenty-one days later, Ajatasatru heard the news, became angry, took the sword and intended to go into the palace to kill his mother. Thanks to the two mandarins, Nguyet Quang and Ky Ba, after all the remonstrances, A Xa The put down his sword and ordered the interior to lock the Queen Mother in the palace and not allow her to visit her father anymore.

The Queen Mother was locked up and was very worried and sad. She then turned towards Ky Xa Quat mountain, where the Buddha was residing, bowed her head, bowed, and said: "In the past, the Buddha often sent Ananda to visit me, but now I am facing a sad situation. The Buddha is majestic and virtuous, my fate is blessed and does not bother the Buddha. I hope the Buddha will allow Maudgalyayana and Ananda to come and comfort me!" After bowing, she felt sad and tears welled up in her eyes. She leaned close to the ground and bowed. At that time, the Buddha at Ky Xa Qua mountain clearly understood the Queen Mother's feelings, immediately sent Maud Lien and Ananda to fly in the sky to the royal palace, the Buddha also left Ky Xa Qua mountain and appeared before the Queen Mother.

Queen Mother Vi De Hi, after bowing and raising her head, suddenly saw Shakyamuni Buddha's bright yellow body sitting on a lotus throne with hundreds of precious things. The left side was during Muc Lien's time, the right side was during Ananda's time. In the sky, the Heavenly Emperor along with the Brahma King and the Devas scattered heavenly flowers to make offerings to the Buddha. The Queen Mother immediately tore off the gold bracelets and pearl necklaces, sobbed on the ground and told the Buddha: "What crime did I commit in my previous life to give birth to such an unfilial child? I hope the World-Honored One will show me a place where there is no suffering or worry so that I can be reborn. I no longer want to be in this evil realm. What a realm full of hells, hungry ghosts and animals! May I no longer hear evil voices and see no more evil voices in my next life! Now I respectfully bow to the World-Honored One and ask him to repent. Please teach me the method of contemplating pure karma."

At that time, Shakyamuni Buddha, from the white hair between his eyebrows, emitted golden light to shine throughout the countless worlds in the ten directions. Then that light turned to gather on the Buddha's crown, transforming into a golden platform as large as Mount Meru. The pure and solemn lands of the Buddhas of the ten directions are clearly visible in that golden platform. Relying on the Buddha's divine power, the Queen Mother saw everything clearly: there is a world like the Heavenly Palace of Freedom, there is a world made of pure lotus flowers, there is a world made up of seven precious substances... The Queen Mother looked at it all carefully and told the Buddha: "Even though those worlds are all pure and solemn, bright and beautiful, I only want to be born in Amitabha Buddha's Pure Land. I hope the World-Honored One will teach me how to think and practice, teach me the method of penetrating right concentration."

After hearing the Queen Mother's words, Buddha smiled. Five-colored light emitted from the Buddha's mouth and shined straight to the head of King Tan Ba ​​Ta La. At that time, although the king was imprisoned in a closed prison, his mind's eyes suddenly opened, so he saw Buddha. The king immediately bowed his head and bowed to naturally increase his spiritual power to attain Anaham fruition.

The Buddha told Vaide Hi: "Amitabha Buddha is not far from here. The Queen Mother should carefully contemplate his Pure Land. I will clearly explain the Pure Land dharma to the Queen Mother, and also let sentient beings in the future follow the practice to be born in the Western World of Ultimate Bliss. If one wants to be born in that land, one must practice the three meritorious karmas:

1.- Thao takes care of her parents, respects her ancestors, is kind-hearted and does not kill, and practices the ten good karma.

2.- Take the three refuges, strictly maintain precepts, and do not violate your dignity.

3.- Develop Bodhi mind, firmly believe in cause and effect, read and recite Mahayana Sutras, and encourage people to practice.

The above three things are the pure karma of the Buddhas of the ten directions."

And after extensively expounding the sixteen dharma contemplations, Queen Mother Vi De Hi and 500 palace maids clearly saw the Land of Ultimate Bliss, clearly saw Amitabha Buddha and the two Bodhisattvas Avalokiteshvara and Mahasthamaprapta. Everyone was very happy, the Queen Mother suddenly had a clear mind and attained Endlessness. Five hundred palace maids aroused the Bodhi mind and wished to be born in the Pure Land world. The Buddha immediately predicted that all of them would be reborn, and after being born in the Pure Land, all of them would attain the "Samadhi of the Buddhas."

Excerpted from the Infinite Life Buddha Sutra

---o0o---

II - LAC AM LAO MOTHER

At one time, the World-Honored One Sakyamuni Buddha was in the garden of Lac Am in the country of Duy Gia La. A poor old woman came to the Buddha and said: "Where do these four sufferings of birth, old age, sickness and death come from, and where do they go? Where do the six consciousnesses, the six senses, and the five elements come from?". Buddha replied: "Birth, old age, sickness, and death do not come from anywhere, nor do they return to any place, until the six consciousnesses, six senses, and five elements do not come from anywhere, nor return to any place. For example, two pieces of wood, rubbing each other, sparks fire, the fire returns to burn the wood, the wood burns out, and then the fire goes out. All dharmas are the same, due to the gathering of causes and conditions, the causes and conditions separate and then perish. They do not come from anywhere, nor do they return to anywhere."

The old woman listened to the Buddha's teachings, her mind opened and she realized the pure Dharma eye.

The Buddha told the assembly: "In the past when I developed the Bodhi mind, there was a life where I was the son of the previous body of this old woman. Later, when her life span was complete, this old woman would be reborn in the Pure Land of Amitabha Buddha. After 60 million kalpas she would become a Buddha with the name Pho Ba Kien, and become the teacher of the Land of Chemistry.

Excerpted from the Lao Mau Sutra

---o0o---

III - KY THI

Ky Thi was from the Liu Song dynasty, wife of Cat Te in Cu Dung. Mr. Te is a descendant of Mr. Cat Hong, and has a family of experts in fairy arts. Particularly, Ky Thi likes Buddhism, has sincere faith in it, and is diligent in worshiping.

One day, while she was weaving, she felt that the sky and earth were brighter than usual. She raised her head and looked up. At first sight, she saw countless phantom beads flying from the West. In the middle, there was a precious lotus throne, its golden body radiating light, illuminating the blue clouds. Ky Thi stopped weaving and stared, feeling very happy and saying to herself: "This must be Amitabha Buddha that the Sutras often talk about!". She quickly bowed her head and bowed, then asked Mr. Te to come out and show her. When Mr. Te looked, he could only see the upper half of the Buddha's body and the phan treasure chest. Everyone in that neighborhood saw the same thing. From then on, Cat Te left the Immortals to follow Buddha, and many people worshiped Buddhism.

Excerpted from the series Minh Tuong Ky

---o0o---

IV - THE DAUGHTER OF THE YEAR TU TU

Daughter of Wei Shizi, from Liang County. Both her father and brothers' family practiced pure karma, and she was also determined to be reborn. As for the mother, she has not yet developed her mind. Not long after she died, her body was warm and not cold. After seven days of resurrection, she immediately sat on a high chair and recited the Infinite Life Sutra. After reciting, she got down from the chair and told her parents: "I went to the Pure Land of Infinite Life Buddha. I went to see the seven-jeweled pond. I saw my father, my brothers and me, each with a big and beautiful lotus flower, and will be reborn there. I'm the only one who doesn't have it. Because I love you, I came back to tell you the news!" After speaking, she closed her eyes. From then on, her mother developed faith and diligence in practicing.

Excerpted from the series Minh Tuong Ky

---o0o---

V - VUONG THI

Vuong Thi, wife of Tiet Ong, mother of Master Danh Cai. Every day, Thi reads and recites the Sutras, diligently practices repentance, and prays for the Pure Land.

In the 11th year of Trinh Quan, due to illness, Thi practiced more earnestly. Not long after, in front of Thi's bed, a red lotus flower the size of a five-pot jar appeared. Then a large blue lotus flower appeared, filling the whole house. At the same time, Amitabha Buddha along with Avalokiteshvara and Mahasthamaprapta appeared in the void. Thi's grandson, Mr. Dai Hung, was standing at the hospital at that time and saw the Buddha towering over the two Bodhisattvas. A moment later, Buddha and two Bodhisattvas hid. Looking back at the time when Vuong Thi died.

Excerpted from the series Tuc Cao Tang Truyen

---o0o---

VI - VIETNAM PHU NHON

Viet Quoc Phu Nhon, surnamed Vuong, wife of Kinh Vuong, uncle of King Triet Tong of the Song Dynasty.

The wife specializes in practicing Pure Land diligently day and night, encouraging concubines and monks to strive for rebirth. In the line of concubines, there was a lazy concubine. Phu Nhan reprimanded: "It is not possible for you alone to destroy the order of our house!". Then the wife ordered him to go away. The concubine was very scared and very repentant, needing to apologize. From then on, the concubine was extremely diligent and practiced without worrying about fatigue. Not long after, one day that concubine told her friends: “I will leave today!”. That night, everyone smelled a strange scent throughout the house, but the concubine was not sick at all and died peacefully. A few nights later, another concubine told the wife: "I dreamed that she told me that thanks to your advice, I was able to be reborn in the Pure Land world. I am extremely grateful. She told me to express my gratitude to you." The wife said: “She fulfilled my dream when I first believed!”.

At night, the wife dreamed that her dead concubine came back to give thanks. Phu Nhon asked: "Can I go to the West?". I replied: "Okay!". Then take the lady away. At first glance, I saw an extremely beautiful world in front of me, with a vast and vast pond. The pond is full of lotus flowers, some big or small, some withered. The wife asked the reason. I explain: "People in the Pure Land practice life, as soon as they make their minds up, a flower sprouts up in this treasured pond. Because the diligent and the late are not the same, there is such a difference between what is fresh and what is withered. Whoever is diligent, his lotus will be bright and luxuriant, but whoever is lazy and retreats, his flower will also wither. If he keeps practicing for a long time without getting discouraged, his recitation of Buddha is mature, until his life span is complete, he decides to be reborn in this lotus." On a large lotus flower, the lady saw a person sitting with a golden crown and a string of pearls shining brightly, so she asked. The concubine replied: "It's Mr. Duong Kiet!". The wife saw another person, but the lotus he was sitting on had not yet bloomed. The concubine said he was Mr. Ma Vu.

The lady asked: "In which lotus will I be born?". The concubine immediately took the wife for a few miles and saw a flower cluster, bright yellow and jade, shining unusually. I pointed and said: "That is the place where women will be born. That is the top-quality golden platform where they will be born!".

After waking up, the wife was very happy in her heart, and the work of self-cultivation and encouraging others became even more serious. That year, on her birthday, early in the morning she held the incense burner in her hand, facing the altar of Avalokiteśvara and standing upright. The relatives in the palace gathered together and then came in front of the deceased's wife to wish her a long life. They looked closely and it turned out that the married couple had already passed away.

Excerpted from the series Lac Ban Van Loai

---o0o---

VII - DELIVERY OF MRS

Giao Ba, a member of the Upper Party, was close to Pham Ba. Pham Ba advised reciting Buddha's name. Giao Ba listened, then entrusted all family matters to her daughter-in-law, then single-mindedly recited Buddha's name.

At the time of his death, he saw Amitabha Buddha appear in the sky. Quan Am and The Chi serve both sides. Giao Ba bowed and said to Buddha: "Thanks to Pham Ba, I was able to see the Buddha. Please wait for me a moment, so I can say goodbye to Pham Ba." Then immediately sent someone to invite Pham Ba. When Pham Ba arrived, Buddha and two Bodhisattvas were still in the sky. Giao Ba stood with her hands clasped in farewell and followed the Buddha.

Excerpted from the series Pure Land Literature

---o0o---

VII - MR. ON TINH VAN'S WIFE

Mr. On Tinh Van's wife, from Tinh Chau, was ill and not strong. Tinh Van taught him to recite Amitabha Buddha's name, and she listened. From then until a full two years later, despite her physical suffering, she silently recited Buddha's name incessantly. One day she told Tinh Van: "I have seen the Buddha who will definitely return to Pure Land next month."

Three days before her death, a large lotus flower, as bright as the newly grown ground, appeared in front of her bed. When the day came, she prepared food to give to her parents and said: "Now I am fortunate to be reborn in the Pure Land. I hope that my parents and my father will focus on reciting Amitabha Buddha and will surely meet each other in the Pure Land." Having finished speaking, she bowed to the Buddha, then sat down and passed away.

Excerpted from the series Pure Land Literature

---o0o---

IX - GENERAL LYING OF PHU NHON

Chung Ly's wife, surnamed Nhiem, from Coi Ke, is the mother of Tri Phu Chung Ly Can. During her life, she diligently cultivated pure karma and carved sandalwood to make a statue of Amitabha Buddha. Every night she often carries a statue on her head to practice religion.

At 98 years old, she is still as strong as ever. One day she called the Trifu and said: "Everyone has Amitabha Buddha, so it's best to throw them away yourself. Everywhere is the Pure Land with no way to return. Mom is about to be reborn, you must diligently recite Buddha's name!". The next morning, she woke up early, burned incense, knelt and recited Buddha's name. After chanting for a while, she remained silent and walked away. Her hands were still clasped across her chest, her body was still kneeling upright.

Excerpted from Buddhist Patriarch Ky

---o0o---

X - MURDER

Ms. Vu's family name is Qin, from Tien Duong, her husband is a fish seller. The son broke the country's laws and his family fortune was ruined. Vu was sad and went to the riverbank to commit suicide. Fortunately, Dharma Master Tu Chieu intervened and advised: "That is the karma that was caused in the previous life, now you should be willing to pay it back. From now on, you should cultivate pure karma, in the future you will reap the fruit of liberation and happiness. Jump into the river to avoid debt, then in the next life you will have to pay more heavily. It's not like just living and practicing reciting Buddha's name!"

Listening to the Dharma Master's explanation, Vu was awakened, so she knuckled her finger in front of the Buddha statue and vowed to chant the Buddha's name. From then on, Ms. Vu diligently practiced recitation for ten years without delay. No matter who she met, she called them all Buddhists.

One day, Ms. Vu invited the monks to come to her house to recite the Infinite Life Sutra, while she recited the Buddha's name. The monks recited the part "Contemplating the image" and then Lady Vu quietly passed away.

Excerpted from the series Buddhist Records

---o0o---
