II - Apostolic Responsibility

Zen master Zong Ze was from Tuong Duong. When he was young, he studied Confucianism and learned the classics. At the age of 29, he went to Truong Lo Pagoda in Chon Chau and became a monk under Tu Zen Master. In the year Nguyen Huu, he became the abbot of Truong Lo pagoda. He took his mother, Tran Thi, back to the house in the East and then advised her to become a monk and recite Amitabha Buddha. Seven years later, Tran Thi was not sick, recited Buddha's name and passed away. The next day, the top of Tran Thi's head was still warm, her face was bright white like jade. The Zen master thought that his gratitude to his mother had been completed.

According to Lo Son's regulations, he established the Lotus Sutra Association, joined the Sangha and continued to practice the Pure Land Monastery, and specialized in reciting Amitabha Buddha, dedicating the vow to pray for rebirth in the Pure Land world. Below is the ancient essay he composed:

People who think that thoughts are thoughts, that are born that are born, that is the error of accepting permanence, but people that think that non-thought is non-thought, that no-birth is no-birth, this is a deluded wrong view. If you understand that thought is non-thought and that birth is non-birth, you will achieve the first meaning.

Therefore, the truth does not contain any dust, above is the emptiness of Buddha to recite, below is the emptiness of salvation to be born. But in Buddhism, not one dharma is abandoned, then all the fundamentals are summed up and there is one discipline "reciting the Buddha's Samadhi and rebirth in the Pure Land", this is the essential technique of restitution. Therefore, one should recite the Buddha's name all day long and still not be contrary to the nature of non-thought. The occipital mind and rebirth is not wrong with the non-living state. Therefore, mortals and Saints both abide in the same place and touch the path. East and West do not cross paths but mentally reach the Pure Land. The logic is of course, the dharma ear is like that. Therefore, in the Sutras it is taught: "If a person hears of Amitabha Buddha and then accepts the title of undisturbed single-mindedness. When he is about to die, Amitabha Buddha and the Holy Assembly appear before that person. At the time of death, his mind will not go crazy, and he will immediately be reborn in the Pure Land of Amitabha Buddha." Although Tu Father and the Master divided into two subjects "conquering" and "receiving" and manifesting in the two realms of "impure" and "pure", the Buddha's original intention was not to think that the impure and evil Saha is a place worth leaving. The pure and solemn Pure Land is a place worth admiring. But it is because beginners who practice the Dharma and whose intellectual power is not yet pure need to rely on pure conditions to easily win.

In this Saha world, Buddha Shakyamuni has passed away, Maitreya Buddha has not yet been born, and Amitabha Buddha in the Pure Land world is preaching the Dharma. In Saha, for Avalokiteśvara and Mahasthamaprapta, we only cherish their names and virtues. As for the Pure Land world, those two great Bodhisattvas are good friends in the same land. In Saha, all kinds of demons race to harass practitioners, while the Pure Land world in great light is completely free of demons. In Saha, evil noises are everywhere, women's beauty is mesmerizing, and the Pure Land world of water, birds, trees, and music all proclaims the color of the Dharma, a man's pure form must not be a woman.

Just like that, comparing the good times to help people practice, there is no place like the Western Pure Land world. There are also many people with weak intelligence who are stubborn and do not believe. Now let me discuss a few things:

People in the world, bored with family troubles, love peace and quiet, so anyone who becomes a monk will admire and praise it. But the sufferings in this Saha world are not just a matter of trouble in the family, but the joys and beautiful things in the Pure Land, the peace of the hermitage, cannot be compared. Knowing that becoming a monk is good or good but not wishing to be reborn is the first delusion.

Thousands of miles away, try to find a wise master to ask for guidance, hoping to enter the sublime Sainthood. But Buddha Amitabha's mind and body are free and his vows are boundless. Once he hears the golden words, no one will not benefit greatly. Wanting to find a master without wanting to see Amitabha Buddha is the second delusion.

Where there is a large crowd of people, there will always be a crowd of ladies, and in a hermitage with a small number of people, there will be no desire to come and stay. In the world of Ultimate Bliss, the Bodhisattva Land of the One Being is so numerous that it is impossible to count, the Supreme Good People gather together in one place. Wanting to be close to the forest without wanting to admire the pure ocean of people is the third delusion.

People in this area don't live more than a hundred years old, but when they are young they are naive, when they are old they are confused, sick, sleepy, taking up half of their life. Bodhisattvas who have not attained patience still have to be confused when they change bodies, Thanh Vans are still dark when they come out of their mother's womb. In this world, every inch of a person's gold and gems is lost out of ten, and those who have not yet attained the fruit of non-returning must be truly heartbroken. The life span of the Pure Land person is limitless, boundless, countless eons. Once she becomes pregnant with a lotus, she will no longer suffer from death and death, but the suffering of illness and old age will also be completely freed, her body will be pure and her state will be pure, so her mind will be clear, and if she diligently practices, she will immediately attain the stage of non-regression, and Buddhahood will be guaranteed. Being transported in a short life in Saha, without realizing the eternal, immortality in Ultimate Bliss is the fourth delusion.

If one is an irreversible person who attains the fruit of Non-birth, living in desires but not thinking about desires, living in the world but not contaminated by the world, with such ability, one can awaken from non-conditioned love, be in the same body of compassion, enter the world and roll in the five defilements, like bright light illuminating the entire surface of the earth, breaking through darkness without being infected by darkness. But if you have not yet reached that level, or only have a little understanding, or only have a few good roots, then you think that you have completely recovered from the four worries and are at the same level of the ten realms, then ignore the Pure Land and become attached to Saha world. Until you become leisurely and optimistic, then you will naturally be a reincarnated person, and will inevitably be dragged by the force of karma and sink into the six paths. Not knowing how to measure one's own strength, hoping to compare with the mighty Bodhisattva, this is the fifth delusion.

Didn't you listen to the Buddha's teachings so you had to make a vow to be born in that Pure Land? Not believing in Buddha's teachings, not making a vow to be born in the Pure Land, is that too delusional? If you believe in the Buddha's words and return to the Pure Land, in times of fire, the Three Realms cannot be restrained, you will be completely free from the eight sufferings of the human world, and completely free from the five afflictions of the heavenly world. There is no need to talk about the Three Paths! There is no such thing as the word evil path, let alone the truth! In the Pure Land, there are only pure One Vehicle teachings, throughout the world there are no minor powers. Paying homage to Amitabha Buddha, the Buddhas of the ten directions will appear together. All the time in the Buddha's great light, the five pillars of troubles and mysterious fortunes are gradually eliminated, everyone always hears the wonderful teachings and Dharma expositions, and the six pillars of Buddha's wisdom are naturally complete. Just like Avalokiteśvara, his body spreads throughout the world in ten directions, depending on the species of living beings, manifesting thirty-two incarnations for salvation. Like Mahasthamaprapta, from reciting the Buddha's name, one attains perfect penetration, and sprinkles Samadhi water along with the three worlds to lead sentient beings out of the house of fire. All deeds of self-benefit and benefit of others are perfect. Enough to see that the Pure Land is not outside the original mind. Amitabha does not leave his own nature. It is the most essential door of liberation, the shortest path of practice. That's why the Mahayana sutras and teachings all point to the Pure Land, and the Saints and Sages all volunteer to be reborn, and at the same time advise everyone to make the same vow. Why is it necessary to be reborn? Because if you want to save others, you have to save yourself first. Only by having salvation will you be able to save others.

Alas! Those who do not worry about the far away will have sadness near and far. After losing their body, they will have to hold on to grief for all eternity. Therefore, I would like to urge the assembly to recite Amitabha Buddha in unison, from a hundred verses to a thousand verses, ten thousand verses to ten thousand sentences, dedicating the vow to be reborn in the Ultimate Bliss.

One night, he dreamed of a man dressed in white and wearing a black turban, with a beautiful and dignified appearance, about thirty years old, clasping his hands and saying to him: "I want to join the Lotus Society, please sign up!". He took out the meeting book and asked, “What is your name?”. Answer: "Pho Hue". As soon as he finished writing, that person asked again: "My brother also wants to enroll in the association." He asked: "What is your brother's name?". Answer: "Pho Hien". With that said, the person disappeared. He told it to everyone. The nobles said: "In the Avatamsaka Sutra in the chapter Leaving the World, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva asked two hundred things, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva used two thousand meanings to answer. Now we have established an assembly to recite the Buddha's name to seek rebirth in Ultimate Bliss, in accordance with the original vows of Buddha and Bodhisattva, so we thank the two Great Monks to come and ask to join the assembly to express their approval." The Association then put the names of two Bodhisattvas at the top of the list. And since then, many people from near and far have expressed their interest to join the association, everyone truly believes and practices.

Lac Ban Van Loai

III - HUU NGHIEM

Zen master Huu Nghiem's ​​family is Ho, from Lam Hai. He became a monk when he was only six years old. After receiving full ordination, he went to Dong Son to study with Divine Illumination Bon Nhu Zen Master, and received the teachings of "One mind and three contemplations", then he specialized in practicing Dharma Flower Samadhi, often showing good omens.

During the year of Thieu Thanh in the Song Dynasty, he lived in hiding on top of Co Son, building a thatched hermitage next to the Tra tree. Therefore, he took the name Tra Am. He strictly maintained the precepts, in addition to three robes and a bowl, he did not store anything else. Every day the Zen master diligently cultivates pure karma. If there are any past actions, most of them encourage rebirth.

Someone asked: Every human being is born into the heavens in the Desire Realm because of the Ten Good Karmas. People are born in the Zen realm in the Rupa Realm due to meditation as a cause. As for people born in the Pure Land, they must practice the wonderful contemplation of non-birth to be able to attain it. Scholars in this world are all confused in the teachings, so they think that being born in heaven is difficult, but returning to the Pure Land is easy. When you say something like that, who would believe it?

He said: "The Dharma is neither difficult nor easy, the difficulty and ease are all in the practitioner. Difficult is the doubt, a short moment can become thousands of miles. Easy is faith, but thousands of miles can be an inch away. As for those who practice the No-birth-wondrous contemplation, they will be reborn, only belonging to the High level of rebirth. You should not try to open an Upper sect, but cover up the Middle and Lower sects. In An Lac Tap, it is said: "There are two classes of people born in the Pure Land: A- "Has the appearance of the mind", is a person who loves the appearance of the Pure Land. B- "Formless mind", is the corresponding type of contemplation. Considering people today, most of whom belong to the Middle and Lower regions, their mental faculties are shallow and their karma is heavy. It would be difficult for anyone to wait until the appropriate contemplation to be reborn. You should know that the Buddha has many means to save sentient beings, such as good concentration and praise, Buddha power and Dharma power, blessings from the place of dedication, and when he is so afraid that he earnestly prays when he is about to die... Among thousands of directions like that, only one can be reborn in all of them. “Good concentration” is the practice of mind-only contemplation, which is Shurangama concentration. "Praise good" is as in the Infinite Life Sutra, which teaches that reciting Buddha's name ten times can lead to rebirth. "Buddha's power" is thanks to Amitabha Buddha's great compassion and prayer power, capturing sentient beings to chant the Buddha's name. Living beings rely on Buddha's power to be reborn immediately, like the common man who followed the King of the Wheel of Wheel, in one day traveling all over the world. It was not the citizen's own power but the blessing of the King of Wheel of Fortune. "Dharma power" is as the Buddha told Lotus Lotus King Bodhisattva to recite the empowerment mantra on the sand and ground and then sprinkle it on the body or on the grave. That person who dies or falls into the three realms will rely on this mantra to be born in the Pure Land. "The meritorious dedicating vow" is from the heart of not killing, having all the precepts, reciting mantras, chanting Sutras, etc., then dedicating solemnly to the Pure Land, then becoming a Pure Land person to be born in the Pure Land. "Dying for help" is when an evil person dies, the appearance of hell appears. Thanks to the intense recitation of Buddha's name, the fierce fire turns into a cool breeze. The Buddha appears in person to receive: Monks like Hung Tuan and Duy Cung, lay people like Thien Hoa and Chung Huc. That's why in the Buddhist scriptures there is a mysterious saying: "The number of Bodhisattvas and those who practice little merit will be reborn, an incalculable number of them."

Buddha said it is easy to be reborn, why do you say it is difficult? We should follow the teachings of the Sutras and argue that it is easy to open the door to liberation for people, and not be attached to it and think that it is difficult to discourage beginners.

At the beginning of Summer in the year of Pure Land, an angel appeared in the air and told him: "The Great Master's pure karma has been completed." Next, he saw a large lotus flower in the palace and heard heavenly music rising around him. He composed a farewell verse to thank them. Seven days later, the Zen Master sat cross-legged and passed away.

IV - PROJECTION

Great Master Nguon Chieu is from Tram Nhien, has the Duong family, and is from Du Hang. At first, he specialized in studying law with Lawyer Hue Giam, then followed Zen Master Than Chieu to listen to the Thien Thai teachings. When he received the Bodhisattva precepts from Dharma Master Quang Tu, the light of the precepts illuminated the entire precepts. Feeling that inspiration, he specialized in studying the Vinaya Pitaka, holding an alms bowl at the market. Later, he stayed at Linh Chi Pagoda for thirty years and ordained monks in more than sixty meetings. Every day, he concentrated on the Pure Land. He often said: "When I live, I propagate the Precepts, and when I die, I return to the Pure Land; that is my possession." He composed the Pure Land Repentance Ceremony and wrote the preface: "Ever since I entered the precepts, I have been dedicated to studying the law. Next, I met Thien Thai Than Ngo Chu Khiem, a Dharma Master who was devoted to his efforts, and then I studied the Buddha Vehicle. And thus I made a vow: "I will always be born in the five evil and depraved worlds of Saha and become a great master to guide living beings to the Buddhist path." I read the story of Cao Tang and saw Master Hue Bo saying that the Pure Land oil is pure. Purity is not my vow. Suppose I enjoy the joy of living in the lotus flower for twelve lifetimes, it is not better than staying in the three paths of saving sentient beings! Therefore, I have held on to my old ambition even more, and for many years I have not had the concept of turning to the Pure Land, and I have also despised people who practice pure karma. One year, I was seriously ill, my body was weak, my mind was confused, and I had no intention. At that time, if I died, I would not know where to go after my illness : Even though my wish is great, I don't have the ability to feel sad and sympathize. I blame myself.

I opened the volume of the Ten Commentaries and saw that it said that the Bodhisattva's initial mind has not yet attained the patience of Non-birth and cannot leave the Buddha. In it, Tri Do Luan is quoted: "If you have a heart of great compassion and wish to be born in the evil realm to save suffering sentient beings, you definitely should not! For example, children should not be far from their parents, young birds should only pass on branches." From that day on, I threw away all my previous studies and specialized in reading the Sutras and treatises on the Pure Land, and for nearly twenty years I never took a break. I thoroughly researched the teachings, reviewing both ancient and modern times. Doubtful notions about the Pure Land disappear like dew; My faith in the Pure Land is growing deeper and stronger. I again saw the commentary on the two subjects "specialized practice" and "mixed practice" by the Venerable Thien Dao: "If you practice professionally, a hundred people will practice and a hundred people will be reborn; if you practice mixed practice, it will be difficult for thousands of people to get one or two."

I consider that my mind is scattered and contemplation is difficult to achieve, so I only focus on reciting the four words of the holy name. For many generations, I left my father and ran away, but now I feel like I know how to come home. I bring the place where I am practicing to advise everyone to practice. The wonderful Dharma door is achieved through faith. Like Mahasthamaprapta, by reciting the Buddha's name with his mind, he attained enlightenment and entered the Samadhi realm. I pondered again, in the past I did not believe in the Pure Land, destroyed the Dharma, despised people, and created countless karma. In my heart, I was filled with shame and fear morning and night. Before the Buddha's platform, I revealed my heart and my five-dimensional figure earnestly repented.

Then I made a great vow: "All sentient beings who practice Buddha's name will be reborn in Ultimate Bliss."

If you want to practice regularly, you must set up a ritual of repentance. I compiled the writings of my predecessors to summarize this Dharma. From beginning to end, ten subjects are presented. Everything here is according to the Buddha's words and the Patriarch's will. The next person who reads it will understand my intention."

In addition, he composed the Commentary on the Meaning Sutra and the Amitabha Buddha Sutra on Meanings. As for his stories, there are more than two hundred volumes in total.

In the sixth year of Chan Hoa, in the fall, he told the monks to recite the Sutra and the Samantabhadra Vow. He sat cross-legged, quietly listening and then peacefully passed away. At that time, everyone heard the sound of heavenly music throughout the void.

V - TRI TIEN

Tri Tien Shaman of the Ly family, Tien Cu people. As a child, he did not like living in a secular world. After becoming a monk, he went to study abroad at Thien Truc Pagoda, where Prime Minister Minh Nghia taught him the teachings of One Mind and Three Contemplations. He returned to his homeland, was instructed to meditate at the dharma conference of Dharma Master Hue at Bach Lien Pagoda, and then he succeeded as teacher. During all times he specialized in commemorating the Pure Land.

Someone asked: "In Dharma Flower Samadhi, one realm is all realms, one body is all bodies, one Buddha is all Buddhas. Why do Dharma Masters not follow the instructions and practice Dharma Flower Samadhi, and why do they insist on being born in the Pure Land?"

He replied: "Great Master Kinh Khe once said: In the chapter on Distinguishing Merits and Contemplating directly on one Dong Cu Do here, all four degrees are fulfilled. Therefore, this one Buddha is all three Buddha bodies, one of them is all of the great assembly. Because the five pillars have not been completely eliminated, it is necessary to practice in Dong Cu Pure Land."

Question: "There are many places in the Pure Land, but it must not be the Pure Land!".

He replied: "We have to practice the Pure Land of Pure Land for many reasons: A- Because there are many teachings in the Sutras. B- Because of deep fate. C- Because of the tendency to have a place for our thoughts to be focused. D- Because of the Buddha's power of prayer."

He taught at Bach Lien Pagoda for thirteen years, facing the West every day to worship, never missing a day.

One day, slightly ill, he went to say goodbye to his relatives and advised him to be diligent in his Buddhist work. Then he returned to the pagoda, set up his bed facing west, placed a statue of Amitabha Buddha on it, invited them to recite the Amitabha Sutra, and before that he sat cross-legged in silence and passed away. The monks at Nang Nhon Pagoda, a nearby pagoda, heard the sound of reciting Buddha's name in the sky, along with the sound of heavenly music playing everywhere, not knowing what the sign was. The next morning, I received news that Master Tri Tien had passed away.

Excerpted from the series Buddhist Records

---o0o---

VI - REFERENCE

Tu Chieu Zen Master, surnamed Duong, from the Former Tang Dynasty. At the age of 14, he became a monk to study Phap Hoa, Phuong Dang in Nam Binh. Then he went to Dong Dich Son to study meditation with Zen Master Than Ngo and was enlightened. He dedicated the solemnity of the Pure Land, diligently practiced the Dharma throughout his life, injected himself with blood and described the Lotus Sutra, and made ten sets of bows for every word. Recite the five canons of the Avalokiteshvara Sutra, the ten canons of the Amitabha Sutra, one thousand volumes of the Lotus Sutra, the Avatamsaka Sutra, the Brahma Vong Sutra, the Pure Land Sutra, etc., each word and each bow, including two hundred and seventy volumes. He specialized in practicing Buddha Recitation Samadhi at a private hermitage called Duc Van. Every night, at the fourth watch, he would sit up and loudly recite Buddha's name. When the Bhikkhus heard his recitation of Buddha's name, they all shuddered with shame.

Every month until the 23rd day, he gathered monks and laity to recite Buddha's name together, the number of participants was usually one thousand people, for a full thirty years.

In the spring of the year of Tuyen Hoa, the year of the Song Dynasty, one day he told his disciples: "Last night I dreamed that the Buddha appeared in a golden body six feet long. That was a sign that I would be reborn." Immediately, seven monks were invited to the temple to help recite. On the afternoon of the seventh day, he suddenly stood up, clasped his hands together and loudly recited Buddha's name, then sat cross-legged and took the mudra to pass away. When he passed away, his teeth were still intact, white and bright as jade.

Excerpted from Buddha Tong Ky

---o0o---

VI B - TE NGOC

Master Qi Yu, surnamed Mac, from Xichuan, became a monk in his childhood. He was very bright, every day he studied the Sutra and memorized several thousand words. At first he studied with Master Than Chi. Later, he directed the teachings of Great Master Tu Bien to study the three contemplations of One Mind. He was the abbot of Buu Tang Pagoda in Dieu Khe and established a large Buddha recitation conference. Next, he went to Hoanh Son pillar, cast a sixteen-meter Buddha statue, and took care of monks and lay people practicing.

One day, in the middle of his night practice, he earnestly told the crowd: "When we do not know how to recite the Buddha's name, we commit countless crimes. The sutras say that if we commit a minor sin, we must fall into hell for nine hundred thousand years of suffering, let alone commit major sins of the heavens! Only by single-mindedly reciting the Buddha's name, in each thought, we will destroy the serious sins of birth and death for eighty million eons, so that we can completely escape the three stages of suffering and achieve the Holy Pure Land. What's more, Father?" Mother let us become monks, we must try to practice the religion to save people, to repay the kindness of being born and nurtured. If we break the precepts and become lazy in cultivating and become depraved, then we are not worthy of being human, how can we fulfill our duty as children? The crowd was moved and all earnestly repented, bowed themselves to the Buddha, and some people broke their foreheads and muted their voices.

In the 6th year of Tuyen Hoa, he passed through the pillars of Thuong Thien Truc Pagoda, did not lie down at night, and practiced Buddhism in the middle of the night holding a Buddha statue on his head. One day, a monk broke the law and he scolded him: "Why are you so stupid like an animal?" Then he repented and said: "Even though he was at fault, he scolded the animals and humiliated the Three Jewels." From then on, every day, he repented before the Three Jewels for a full three years.

In the fall of the first year of Kien Viem, he told the Abbot Tu Hue: "The Da Buu Buddha Tower appeared in front of my bed, but it is not the place I want. I just want to be close to Amitabha Buddha! You should gather the Sangha to recite Buddha's name for me!". The Chief Minister immediately rang the bell to gather over a hundred monks to chant in unison. Moments later he bowed his head in respect and said: "Buddha has come!". Then he sat upright and passed away.

Excerpted from Buddha Tong Ky

---o0o---

VII - PRIDE

Great Master Tu Tinh of the Du family, from the Former Tang Dynasty, studied the Lotus Sutra with Dharma Master Duc Tang. Once he realized the wonderful principles, he concentrated on reciting Buddha's name, every day reciting the Sutra and contemplating the West. He established a monastery to welcome the Sangha.

In the year of Tuyen Hoa, there was an enemy rebellion in the land. He immediately went to the place where the enemy general was stationed and asked to give his life to all the people in the city. The enemy general joined his hands in admiration.

He painted Buddha statues very skillfully. Whenever disaster was about to happen, he went into a quiet room to recite Buddha's name and meditate for a long time before picking up a pen. One day he painted a statue of Amitabha Buddha. The Buddha statue suddenly emitted light that took a long time to extinguish. While the statue was releasing light, the crowd gathered to pay homage. That's why everyone called him Du Di Da.

Someone asked him why he didn't meditate? He replied: "Binh Sinh only knows how to recite Amitabha, but does not know what is wrong with meditating! Just to reach the Five Lakes, cool moon and wind, peace and tranquility must arise!".

In the winter, the seventh year of Shaoxing, Song Dynasty, he sat down to meditate on Buddha. Seven days later, he suddenly stood up, burned incense to worship Buddha, then sat cross-legged and passed away. The top of the head stays warm for seven days without getting cold. The strange scent lasted seven days without dissipating.

Excerpted from the books of Buddhist Records

Tay Ho Cao Tang Su Luoc

---o0o---

VIII - LIKE STATION

Like the Shaman Tram, whose family is Tieu, from Vinh Gia. His mother dreamed of a stupa and gave birth to him. When he was young, he became a monk with Dharma Master Xa Khe Khanh. Later he went to study with Dharma Master Hue Giac Ngoc in Hoanh Son. The star was able to save him, and shortly after, he penetrated the entire Thien Thai teachings. He was the abbot of Tho Thanh pagoda in Xa Khe. Every day outside of teaching hours, he recited the Lotus Sutra one set and recited Buddha's name twenty thousand verses.

There are people who want to be appointed as Tri, but he won't let them. That person tried to resent him and kill him. In the middle of the night, that person brought a knife into his room. Seeing that the guests were filling the whole room, he quickly retreated. The next night, that person brought the knife into the room again. It was dark and he couldn't find the way out. A few days later, that person also brought a knife in. Seeing him split into more than ten people, all identical, that person ran away in terror. Later, that person told the above story to his close friends, because of that, everyone knew that he was a strange god.

He slept very little. On rainy nights, he sat naked in the thick grass, chanting the Lotus Sutra, sacrificing his body to mosquitoes. The public thought that he was old and advised him to reduce his asceticism. He said: "Foolish mosquitoes and gnats cannot receive Buddha's vehicle. I only hope that they will suck my blood and listen to me chant the Sutras to create Pure Land karma for them!". The next person mentioned that the place where he often sat to be bitten by mosquitoes was "Noi Van Dai" (mosquito breeding station) as a souvenir. Not long after, he gave up all his work and lived freely in a small hermitage, diligently cultivating and purifying his karma every day.

In September of the 10th year of Shaoxing, he was free of illness and passed away, reciting Buddha's name as usual. When he died, he received many five-colored relics.

He compiled the book "Pure Karma Ky" and explained the Contemplation of Sutras.

Excerpted from the series Buddhist Records

---o0o---

IX - UDAM

Uu Dam Sect Master of the Tuong family, from Don Duong, became a monk at Lo Son Dong Lam Temple. Later he stayed at Dieu Qua Pagoda in Don Duong. At the beginning of the year Chi Dai of the Yuan Dynasty, there was an edict abolishing Lien Tong. He said to himself: "I personally received the Pure Land Dharma from Lien Tong for nearly thirty years. How can I let this sect disappear in my life!". He immediately bowed to the Buddha and vowed to restore it. Then he composed ten volumes of Lien Tong Buu Giam. Now I take a few essential passages from that collection:

Everyone who practices the Pure Land clearly has to oppose birth and death. It is not a matter of talking without doing, but must consider it a very important tool that it is their duty to complete. You should think about impermanence quickly, days wait for no one. If you half believe, half doubt, half advance, half retreat, what should you do when impermanence comes? How to escape reincarnation? If you are a believer, starting from today, develop great courage and great diligence. Don't discuss the truth, don't understand the truth, don't discuss the nature or not the nature, just straight-facedly hold the sentence "Namo Amitabha Buddha", as solid as leaning on a big mountain, nothing can shake it. You have to concentrate, you have to pay attention, or meditate and recite, or meditate and recite, or recite all the time, or recite ten times, or recite silently, or recite out loud, or recite the mantra, or chant, etc. Every meditation is Buddha, every mind never leaves the Buddha. Reciting in the morning, reciting in the evening, also reciting when walking, also reciting while sitting. Don't let your thoughts wander, chant Buddha's name without leaving your mind. All hours and all days must not be separated, discreetly connected. Like a chicken incubating eggs, it needs constant heat. Reciting the Buddha's name like this is called "Continuously pure recitation". Use your wisdom to clearly observe the Pure Land, which is your own mind. This is the practice of a wise person. No matter whether you encounter painful or happy, adverse or favorable conditions, just recite Amitabha Buddha. Not a single change of mind, not a single thought of regression, nor a single bit of mixed thoughts. Enduring until my last breath, I decided not to have any other thoughts, only longing to return to the Western world of Ultimate Bliss. With such effort, ignorance and karma will naturally disappear, and all afflictions and afflictions will naturally disappear. I will definitely see Amitabha Buddha face to face, and when I die, I will definitely be reborn as a high-class person.

If a person recites Buddha's name but his afflictions are not yet purified, when evil thoughts arise, he must immediately self-criticize. If you have thoughts such as: greed, anger, ignorance, jealousy, when lying to the self, high tribute, pride, flattery, wrong views, etc., you must loudly chant the Buddha's name, focus on mindfulness, do not let the bad thoughts continue, until they are destroyed, no longer able to arise again. If you have good thoughts such as thoughts of deep faith, sincerity, dedication, compassion, humility, equality, expediency, patience, precepts, joy and renunciation, meditation, diligence, right wisdom, etc., you must preserve them for growth. You must strictly maintain morality, do not do evil deeds, do not raise cats, ferrets, chickens and pigs, and do not work in the fishing yard. You should know that all the good people in the Pure Land, by abandoning all evil and practicing good deeds, were born in the Pure Land and remained at the level of unsurpassed Bodhi. Those who recite Buddha's name must learn to follow Buddha, and should consider giving up evil and doing good as their duty.

People who recite the Buddha's name and want to be born in the Pure Land must often think that all things in the world are impermanent, with creation and destruction, with birth and death. If they do not specialize in practicing Buddhism, they will die here and be reborn there, circulating in the four births and six paths, never knowing when they will be liberated. Now I have the good fortune to hear the Buddha's teachings and practice pure karma, so I concentrate on reciting the Buddha's name. When I leave this body, I will be born in the Pure Land in the precious lotus flower, enjoy purely pure joys, completely escape birth and death, and attain Bodhi. That is the duty of a great man. As soon as he was sick, he immediately wiped off his body and mind, without any hesitation, facing the West, thinking of Amitabha, Avalokiteshvara and Mahasthamaprapta, and then single-mindedly chanted "Namo Amitabha Buddha" without ceasing. For all worldly affairs, don't worry about it, don't be attached to it. If random thoughts arise, you must urgently recite Amitabha Buddha's name and earnestly pray to be quickly reborn in the Pure Land. So, decided to be reborn. If your fate has not yet expired, then you will be healthy. Because reciting the Buddha's name single-mindedly has the power to destroy countless sinful obstacles. Be careful not to become attached to the world. This temporary fake body lasts for a while, dies and dies, just pray for rebirth, without any hesitation. Like taking off dirty clothes and changing into clean clothes, abandoning the mortal body, stepping onto the Buddha land, there is nothing more noble than that.

Regarding true faith, practicing is because you want to be reborn in the Pure Land world, focusing on reciting a single sentence of Amitabha Buddha. This one thought alone is our Original Master, this one thought alone is the Buddha, this one thought alone is the mighty form of destroying hell, this one thought alone is the precious sword that cuts down the evil hordes, this one thought alone is the great light illuminating the darkness, this one thought alone is the strong boat through the sea of ​​suffering, this one thought alone is the magic medicine of the physician, this one thought alone is the shortcut out of the three worlds, this one thought alone is Amitabha's original nature, this one thought alone is the Pure Land of mind. Try to clearly write down this Amitabha Buddha sentence in your heart so you don't forget it. Thoughts are always present, thoughts never leave the mind. Think of nothingness like that, think of things like that when you have things, think of peace and happiness like that, think of sickness and suffering like that, think of life like that, and think of death like that. With such a clear and unambiguous thought, why do we need to ask people to find the way home!…

When he finished writing, he sent it to all the virtuous and virtuous people for testimony, no one could change a word. He presented the book to the Yuan Dynasty king, asking to restore Lien Tong's teachings. The court approved and honored him as the Patriarch, taking the title of Venerable Ho Khe.

In the year of Chi Thuan, he passed away peacefully.

Excerpted from the sets of Tran Giang Phu Chi

Lien Tong Buu Giam

---o0o---

X - HUE Hanh

Hue Hanh Lawyer from Thanh Chieu, ordained to study law in Linh Chi. Later, he became the abbot of Dien Tho Pagoda in Hangzhou, specializing in cultivating pure karma. Every time I talk to someone, I always advise reciting Buddha's name. He built precious towers and cast statues of the Western Three Saints. His appearance was majestic and majestic, and everyone praised him as being the best. At the same time, he established an association to recite Buddha's name.

One day, Mr. Giang Tu Nhiem dreamed of a Saint Monk holding a throne in his hand and descending from the sky, saying: "Lawyer Hue Hanh will sit on this court." On this very day, just as Ton Cu Si, a friend of the association, had come to say goodbye to him, he passed away while sitting at home, cross-lying. He went to visit Ton Lay Si's house, then returned to the temple and told the crowd: "Friend Sun has gone, I will go too!". The crowd gathered to recite Buddha's name. He spoke in verse:

Amitabha is always chanting

White proud heart and mind

Hold your heart tightly and don't give up

Decided to give birth to An Duong!

Having finished speaking, he sat down respectfully and passed away.

---o0o---

noi_dung:
B 4 - MONKS

I - DIEU THANH

Nun Dieu Thanh, daughter of the Ha family in Ho Chau. She is naturally intelligent. Her mother worshiped Buddha. When she was a child, every time she saw her mother worshiping Buddha and reciting Buddha's name, she immediately clasped her hands and recited after her mother. At the age of 21, she became the daughter-in-law of the Vuong family. Less than half a year, her husband died. Her father-in-law was originally a vegetarian and recited Buddha's name. Her husband's family is poor, so she has to work to provide for her husband's parents. Early in the morning and at night, she recited the Avatamsaka Sutra, recited Buddha's name, and planned to do her daily routine, spending more than ten years like that. Later, her father-in-law became a monk and her mother-in-law passed away, so she became a nun at Quang Nghiem hermitage. After receiving full ordination, she maintained strict precepts and was even more dedicated to reciting the Buddha's Sutras.

In the 19th year of Gia Khanh, in the Qing Dynasty, she was slightly ill and told the crowd: "My life is over, three days later I will return to the West. Everyone should try their best to practice, and in the future we can meet each other. Don't forget my advice!" On the third day, while she was sitting and reciting the Buddha's name, she suddenly raised her head and said: "Amitabha Buddha has come to pick you up, I will go!". After saying that, she immediately closed her eyes and passed away, at the age of 47.

Excerpted from Nhiem Huong Tuc Tap

---o0o---

II - DAO CANG

Nun Dao Cang, surname Tran, surname The Thien, from Gia Hoa. At the age of 17, she became a monk at La Am in Tu Chau. She likes to live alone and alone. She saw the story of Co Duc's fate and became ambitious. After receiving full ordination, she went to Quoc Thanh Pagoda in Thien Thai and studied meditation with Great Master Buu Lam. When she appeared before the Great Master, she immediately asked: "What is the appearance of a great person?". The great master said: "Wait until you have eliminated the five hindrances, then I will tell you." She said: "A cruel kiss! The world has deceived the Venerable!". The great master said: "Where did you learn such nonsense?". She suddenly sweated all over her back. Suddenly enlightened, she bowed. The great master replied: "What is the appearance of a great person?". She immediately stretched out her arms. Great master presses.

She was given a reason to stop going to school and live in a hermitage in Nam Ho. The house was leaking, but she still lived safely. Truthful speech and conduct, favorable and unfavorable circumstances do not move the heart. The Avatamsaka Sutra, one word, one bow, completed three sets, and recited the Great Prajna Prajna for several dozen sets. Gradually, her virtue spread, and donors continued to practice. Not long after, the thatched hermitage was torn apart and the massive halls were lost. Isolated the Buddha Recitation Hall to gather people to recite Buddha's name, for nearly forty years, day and night, the bells and gongs sounded incessantly. She once wrote an autobiographical verse:

Study diligently year after year

From now on, there is no such thing as yes or no

When you go home, don't sit at home forever

Be zealous for people with good roots.

In the winter of Gia Khanh's 25th year, she fell ill with a mild illness. On November 11, she told them: "Tomorrow's Tiger hour is my time to go!". When the time came, she recited the verse:

Eighty-eight years, without greed or attachment

Now returning home, the water in the moon appears.

Then she told them to recite Buddha's name in unison. For a moment she turned her face to the right and passed away.

Oh ! There is Zen and there is Purity, which again appears in the place of female exile. How rare!

Excerpted from Nhiem Huong Tap

---o0o---

III - LAN NHA

Nun Lan Nha, surnamed Tran, from Ninh Quoc. Her husband became a monk at Tay Thien pagoda. She also became a nun at Tam Thua hermitage. A little while later, she went to Lan Nhan hermitage and got the name. During the day, she depends on the nuns to take care of the hut's affairs. At night, she meditated in private and recited Buddha's name. She likes asceticism and dresses frugally. Her biological brother sometimes sent food and clothes to her, and she reluctantly said: "I have become a monk. If I often go back and forth with my brothers, it will be no different from being at home."

Later, she was free of illness, sat down to recite Buddha's name, and was reborn. During the hot weather, for seven days her body did not sweat.

Excerpted from Nhiem Huong Tap

---o0o---

IV - ENLIGHTENMENT

Nun Dao Ngo, surname Hue Tam, surname Uong, from Song Giang. Her father passed away early, and she had no brothers, so she lived with her mother and grandmother. Her family was very poor, she did not get married, and took care of her mother and grandmother every morning and night. Shortly after, she became a monk at Kiet Tuong Monastery, then went to Ksitigarbha Monastery to receive full ordination, diligently reciting Buddha's name day and night.

In June of the 13th year of Dao Quang, her mother recited Buddha's name and passed away. Seven days ago, my grandmother also passed away. On the fifth day of the eighth month, she asked the Venerable Dao Sanh and said: "The big work has been completed, I want to return to the Pure Land. Please, Venerable, buy me a birthday cake and tomorrow ask them to recite Buddha's name for one day to help me be reborn." That afternoon she took a shower and cleaned herself. Every morning, they gather to recite Buddha's name for a whole day. At night she told everyone: "Buddha came to take me!". Then she sat cross-legged and passed away.

Excerpted from the series Thanh Hien Luc Tuc Bien

---o0o---

V - LIKE TRI

Nun Nhu Tri, nicknamed Le Tuyen, surnamed Vuong, from Kinh Trieu, has been a vegetarian since childhood and likes to listen to the chanting of Buddhist scriptures. Seeing her cousin become a monk in the mountains, she wanted to admire her very much, but because her parents loved her so much, she did not dare to say anything. She often goes to the mountains to stay with her sister, carrying firewood, carrying water, and eating vegetable sauce.

At the age of 18, she became seriously ill and medicine was ineffective. While in a coma, she only wanted to shave her hair and become a monk, and said nothing else. Because she was so afraid, her parents set up an incense burner, prayed to Buddha to bless her with good health, and promised to let her become a monk. Her illness naturally subsided, and within a few days she was healthy. At the age of 21, she prayed to the Venerable Dong Bao for salvation, then in the winter of that year she prayed for ordination. Early in the evening, she repented and studied the law very diligently, but suddenly her old illness returned, and she forced herself to accept the Ten Precepts. The monk took pity on her and told her to go back to the temple to recuperate and wait until she was healthy to receive full ordination.

Returning to the temple, her illness got worse and could not be cured, but she still recited Buddha's name incessantly. One day, she opened her eyes, looked up into the void, clasped her hands, and loudly called Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva three times. At the same time, she made three absolutions and then she quietly passed away. It was November 17, 8th year of the Republic of China.

Excerpted from the episode Centre Dai Vân Sinh Tap

---o0o---
