tom_tat: In the past, there were many intellectuals, and the nature of those who studied the Dharma was superior, so anyone who practiced any discipline could attain enlightenment.
noi_dung:
I. NARRATIVE

Medicine doesn't matter whether it's expensive or cheap, it's good medicine to heal the disease.

The Dharma does not discuss advantages or disadvantages. It is a wonderful Dharma that is appropriate at the right time and opportunity.

In the past, there were many intellectuals, and the nature of those who studied the Dharma was superior, so if you practiced any discipline, you could attain enlightenment.

Nowadays, there are few intellectuals, the nature of those who study the Dharma is weak, outside of the Pure Land discipline it is difficult to hope for liberation.

I'm secretly ashamed that in my previous life I didn't plant good roots, my blessings were short, my karma was deep and heavy. During the age of learning, I did not meet good teachers and good friends early, did not listen to the teachings of Thanh Hien, only competed to drink the poison of Han Du and Au Duong Tu's rejection of Buddhism. Occasionally, karmic retribution appears, causing illness to stagnate for several years, almost becoming disabled, unable to handle anything.

While I was sick, I woke up and examined myself: Heaven and Earth, ghosts and gods are very wise, and there are many Sages and Saints from ancient times to present. If Buddhism is truly as bad for humanity as the Han and Au families say, then not only will the Holy kings and wise mandarins not allow it to spread, but the heaven and earth demons have long since been exterminated, waiting for the Han family and the Au family to discuss nonsense to refute it. Buddhism does not use power to force people to obey. If it were not for virtue to touch people's hearts and truth to convince people's minds, it would not be easy to still have great circulation today!

The book Trung Dung says: The Tao of a gentleman, even a foolish person, can know it and do it, but at the extreme of the Saint's time (the world of the Saint), there are still places where one cannot know and cannot do it.

Even though the Han family of the Au family is intelligent, he is not yet a Saint, so how can he understand the truth, where the Saints claim that there are still things they don't know and can't do. Is it true that the Buddha Dharma is so profound that ordinary wisdom cannot comprehend it?

Considering this, I repented of my rashness and paid attention to Buddhism, and from that day on, my illness gradually improved.

I developed my faith and became a monk.

After a period of studying the Buddha's teachings, I reflected on myself: if I did not rely on the Buddha's vast compassion, it would be difficult to be liberated in this life. From then on, I concentrated on reciting Buddha's name, determined to seek rebirth in Ultimate Bliss. Even though I spent many years listening to the Sutras and listening to lectures, studying Zen and studying the Law, it was only to discover the principles of the Pure Land so that I could become a high-ranking person and be reborn.

I am angry because my body is weak and my health is poor, so I cannot practice the Dharma courageously, but my faith and vow are very strong. Not only can Zen Masters and Lecturers not be able to shake my will, even if the Buddhas appear and tell me to practice other dharmas, I still bow to Buddha and apologize, not determined not to change my will and leave this and follow that, contrary to my original vow. Because my karma is too heavy, I have never been able to recite Buddha's name Samadhi. The more I think about it, the more ashamed I become!

---o0o---

tieu_de: II THE VALUE OF THE PURE LAND Dharma
tom_tat: There was a monk who studied Zen Buddhism for many years and understood all the teachings. His eyes saw the four empty oceans and he swore to attain One Vehicle.
noi_dung:
II THE VALUE OF THE PURE LAND Dharma

There was a Venerable who studied Zen Buddhism for many years and understood all the teachings. His eyes looked at the four empty oceans and swore to himself that he had attained One Vehicle attainment.

The Venerable followed the example of Thien Tai Bodhisattva to interview all the wise men.

One day, the Venerable came to Hong Loa Mountain to question me. At that time, I wanted to collect Tien Thai teachings to annotate the Amitabha Sutra Commentary, so that beginners who study Buddhism can make some progress. But in the original Essential Commentary, the writing is deep and the ideas are hidden, which is very inconvenient for beginners to study.

I respectfully presented the Venerable with a set of Essential Commentaries and expressed my desire to prepare notes to present to the Venerable.

The Venerable said: "I have read the Amitabha Sutra, and I have seen many passages in it that say: The robe of Hoa Nghiem, the secret marrow of the Dharma flower, the heart essence of Buddhas, and the guidance of Bodhisattvas are all outside this place. These words clearly crush Zen Buddhism and its teachings and praise the Pure Land excessively. It is truly defaming the wheel of Dharma and leading sentient beings into a place of doubt.

Unexpectedly, Great Master Nguoi Ich was a knowledgeable person but did not directly point to the true mind and propagate the teachings, and later wrote this Essential Commentary to act as a talisman to protect the body of stupid women and stupid women. It causes so many lay people as well as ordained people to hold tightly to one discipline and abandon all virtues, to preserve the pool water but forget the ocean, racing each other down a path of delusion that completely contradicts the path of enlightenment, destroying the Buddha seed. What a sin. Those who have the will to repay Buddha's kindness should quickly destroy the Essential Commentary, why would they want to write notes to help that volume circulate?

Waiting for the Venerable to calm down, Dharma Master Mo Lien slowly said: "You think that Great Master Nguoi Ich who compiled this collection of Essential Commentaries is guilty of a very serious crime, that is, you only know the top of the branch without knowing the origin. You must know that the crime is not really in the Essential Commentaries of Great Master Nguoi Ich, but rather in Buddha Shakyamuni, Amitabha Buddha, the Buddhas of the ten directions and the Pure Land Three Sutras and in the Mahayana Sutras such as Hoa Nghiem, Phap Hoa, Buu Tich, Bi Hoa, etc., at the same place as the great Bodhisattva Patriarchs such as Manjushri, Pho Hien, Ma Minh, Nagarjuna, Tri Jia, Thien Dao, Thanh Luong, Vinh Minh, etc.

If he is truly the great Dharma King who claims to cure that crime, then everyone can obey his words. Otherwise, it would be no different from the stupid people in the countryside who call themselves Emperor, make their own laws, and disobey the government's edicts. It would be difficult for them to avoid death. Your accusation is indeed slandering Buddha, slandering Dharma, slandering Sangha and will surely fall into hell and suffer for many lifetimes, how pitiful!

The Dharma Master said up to this point, the Venerable Master said: "Why do you go against the norm and say that the sins of the Buddha, Bodhisattva and Patriarch are responsible? Please clarify the reason. If your words are correct, I dare not disobey them."

Dharma Master Mo Lien said: "Dharma Tathagata appeared in the world because of a great cause and effect. What is a cause and effect? ​​He only wants to help sentient beings gain enlightenment and enter Buddha's knowledge and knowledge to become a Buddha.

That is the Buddha's sole purpose of saving sentient beings.

Strict because the nature of sentient beings is not the same, some have great faculties, some have small faculties, delusions are obstacled for those who are deep and some who are shallow. The Buddha could not practice education according to his ultimate intention, he had to teach according to the level of each class of people, and give medicine according to the illness. Because of the TRUTH, the RIGHT is revealed, then the RIGHT is revealed and the TRUTH is revealed. The place above the One Vehicle dharma enunciates many teachings. For people with mature good roots, they will be able to reach the shore of enlightenment. With deep and thick karma, it's time to get out of the world. Buddha worked hard to teach and follow each person to guide them. What a great grace and virtue, no grace in the world can compare to it.

Furthermore, because all dharma methods rely on self-power, even if there are good people with deep roots who fully realize their own mind, if their views and thoughts are still a little impure, they are still living beings in the cycle of birth and death; Furthermore, once conceived, the body of the five skandhas will certainly come into contact with emotional scenes; There are few people who go from enlightenment to enlightenment, but there are many people who go from delusion to deeper delusion. The upper level is still in such danger, not to mention the middle and lower levels.

You must know that by self-reliance, cutting off views is as difficult as crossing a river forty miles wide, but cutting four or four is thousands of times more difficult. Liberation from birth and death is not an easy matter.

Therefore, the methods that specialize in self-reliance do not satisfy the Buddha's wish to save sentient beings, because they cannot benefit all three classes of living beings.

There is only one discipline of REMEMBERING THE BUDDHA AND PRAYING FOR BEING IN THE PURE LAND. Based on the vast vow of Amitabha Buddha, all sentient beings of the six paths, regardless of whether their good roots are mature or not, regardless of whether their bad karma is heavy or light, if anyone is willing to FULLY BELIEVE in making the vow to recite the name of Amitabha Buddha, then decide to be guided by the Buddha to the Pure Land of Rebirth: they are good roots. If you are mature, you will quickly reach Buddhahood, and even if you endure heavy evil karma, you will be able to attain sainthood.

You should know that the method of reciting the Buddha's name is the essential way of saving sentient beings of the Buddhas, and is a wonderful dharma that can be practiced by saints, great Bodhisattvas, and ordinary people. That's why the Mahayana Sutras always mention it, and no one in the past has followed it.

He prided himself on being knowledgeable about Zen Buddhism and good at its teachings, but falsely said that those who propagated the Pure Land sect were defaming the Dharma and destroying the Buddha race. It was clear that he had fallen prey to the devil, went crazy and committed the crime of hell. Why do you accept delusion as enlightenment that only human beings consider to be such evil?

Considering Buddha Shakyamuni and Amitabha Buddha, they made great vows in their past lives

save sentient beings. Buddha Shakyamuni appeared

In the impure world, use impurity and suffering to conquer and conquer

motivate sentient beings to practice. As for Amitabha Buddha, he sat in the Pure Land and used it for joy and pleasure to receive and train people to become saints.

He saw that poor people in the countryside were still able to recite the Buddha's name and quickly scorned the Pure Land. Why not carefully review the Avatamsaka Sutra's chapter on Entering the Dharma Realm. After his enlightenment and realization, Buddha Samantabhadra, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva, taught the Dharma the ten great vows to dedicate to rebirth in the Western Pure Land to quickly attain Buddhahood, and also advised the entire ocean of people in the Flower Store. In terms of the vast community in Hoa Tang, there is no one who is an ordinary person or a dual vehicle, there are only 41 Dharmakaya Bodhisattvas, who simultaneously destroy ignorance and attain the Dharma nature, all of whom can manifest themselves as Buddhas to save birth in a world without Buddhas. In the Hoa Tang Sea there are countless Pure Lands, which are determined to dedicate themselves to seek rebirth in the Western world of Ultimate Bliss, enough to see that the Land of Ultimate Bliss is the mystical gate of escape from suffering, a shortcut to becoming a Buddha.

For that reason, from ancient times to the present, many monasteries and monasteries that belong to Zen, Buddhism, or Vinaya, all in every place, morning and night, recite the Buddha's name and make a vow to pray for rebirth in Ultimate Bliss.

He is a person in Zen who goes to visit the forest, every day he recites the Buddha's name and vows to return to destroy the Pure Land?

The Avatamsaka Sutra is the king of the Sutras and is also the king of the Tripitaka. If you do not believe in the Avatamsaka, you will be a person of icchantika. If you receive it completely, it will be difficult to escape the suffering of hell.

I want to escape suffering and seek rebirth in the Pure Land, but you want to endure suffering and destroy Hoa Nghiem. Well, you keep your will, I'll keep my religion. Please go away, I don't want to argue with you anymore!

---o0o---

tom_tat: The Venerable said: "The Dharma is precious in the place of dissemination. If there are doubts, you need to ask to resolve them. How can you chase away such things?"
noi_dung:
III. PRACTICE MEDITATION

The Venerable said: "The Dharma is so precious that it is spread everywhere. If there are doubts, we need to ask them to resolve them. How can you chase them away like that?"

I have heard: Bhikkhu Gia Na is everywhere, the place where Buddha resides is called Thuong Tich Quang. In this world, we only need to attain the Dharma body and the land we live in is the Pure Light. Do you have to use your mind to destroy the East (Sa Ba) and seek the West (Ultimate Bliss)?"

Dharma Master Mo Lien said: "Why do you say it so easily? Even though the Pure Land of Pure Light is that, it is that. But if you are not yet a wise and virtuous person with ultimate virtue, and have not yet attained the Bhikkhu Dharmakaya, then you cannot fully take advantage of it. In the Complete teachings, the level of Ten Levels and Equal Enlightenment is still a part of the certification. If you have attained the Bhikkhu Dharmakaya, then you can freely say that the Dharmakaya of the Dharmakaya is the Pure Land. But if you have not yet attained the Dharmakaya, then it is clear that you are talking and counting. of, it will be difficult to avoid death from hunger and cold."

The Venerable said: "The sentence "Mind-only Pure Land of Amitabha's nature" is a common saying of the Zen people, how could it be wrong?

Mo Lien Dharma Master said: "The words of Zen say that it is a treatise on the nature of reason, not on cultivation. This is because you want people to first realize the nature of reason and then follow the nature to practice and practice to reach the sublime, enter the Saint, that is, sentient beings and become Buddha. Why is your understanding so crazy, accepting things with such confusing reasons?

Just now you thought that abandoning the East for the West would lead to birth and death, but you did not expect that accepting the East and rejecting the West would fall into the error of annihilation. Before attaining Buddhahood, is anyone outside the scope of letting go (taking away)? My Buddha, from the moment he developed the Bodhi mind, spent three countless eons cultivating the Bodhisattva conduct, seeking to become a Buddha and saving sentient beings, ending karma or attaining the true vehicle. Is there anything that is not renunciation?

You must know that the Tathagata wants sentient beings to soon realize the Pure Light and the Dharmakaya, so he especially advises everyone to recite the holy name to seek rebirth in Ultimate Bliss.

The Venerable replied: "The Venerable Cao Ba said that the Pure Land Dharma is a true teaching, not a true teaching. Why do the Hoa Tang Hai people all vow to be reborn? The Venerable Cao Ba in this life has attained Holy Spirit and wisdom that is unimaginable. It is all a manifested Bodhisattva. Could it be that he said it wrong?

Dharma Master Mo Lien replied: "In the Avatamsaka Sutra on the chapter Entering the Dharma Realm, volume 80, after Samantabhadra attained the level of Enlightenment, Bodhisattva Samantabhadra immediately recited verses praising the wonderful merits of the Tathagata. Then, in the 81st book, that is, the Vows chapter, Samantabhadra expounded the ten royal vows, advising Shan Tai and the great Bodhisattvas to all vow to dedicate themselves to seek rebirth in the Western Land of Ultimate Bliss. When Samantabhadra finished speaking, Samantabhadra preached the ten kingly vows, advising Samantabhadra and the great Bodhisattvas to all vow to dedicate themselves to the Western Land of Ultimate Bliss. When Samantabhadra finished speaking, Samantabhadra preached the ten kingly vows. Buddha praised twice. The entire assembly in the Dharma assembly obeyed.

Gu Duc once said: The method of reciting the Buddha's name to seek rebirth in the Pure Land, only Buddha and Buddha can be fully understood, great Bodhisattvas still do not fully understand. Although Cao Bo was a Bodhisattva, because during his time, the Avatamsaka Sutra had not yet been translated, so he could not predict it. After he passed away more than 50 years, all 81 volumes of Hoa Nghiem were completely translated.

According to the Avatamsaka Sutra, those with great intelligence and wisdom all returned to the Pure Land.

The Dai Tap Sutra says: "In the time of the end of the Dharma, with countless cultivators, it is difficult for a single person to be liberated. Only relying on the Dharma door of reciting the Buddha's name can escape samsara." See here, the Pure Land period covers all six paths of sentient beings.

He believes in Cao Ba but does not believe in the Avatamsaka Sutra or Dai Tap Sutra, which is no different than someone who believes in the instructions of a district official but does not follow the President's edict.

The Venerable asked: "His Holiness Cao Ba is already a manifested Bodhisattva, so why wait to read the Sutras to know?".

Dharma Master Mo Lien replied: "The problem of propagating Buddhism is not an easy one. It is not said that one must have the written testimony of the Sutra to gain confidence. The Avatamsaka Sutra is far superior to other Sutras, so there is no reason to infer, while the Avatamsaka Sutra has not yet circulated."

The Venerable asked again: "When the Nirvana Sutra had not yet been transmitted, why did Mr. Dao Sanh declare in advance that all first-class chandis have Buddha nature? Could it be that Mr. Cao Ba shot Dao Sanh?"

Dharma Master Mo Lien replied: "All sentient beings have Buddha nature, Icchantika means all sentient beings also have Buddha nature. All intellectuals can understand and predict. As for the issue of rebirth in the Pure Land to quickly complete Buddhahood, other than Avatamsaka, other Sutras absolutely do not mention it. Who dares to boast about their own knowledge to make sense!

Besides, how can we know clearly where the two of them practiced? We shouldn't compare the two for mere discussion.

You must know that Bodhisattvas propagate the Dharma in many ways: either for or against, or hidden or obvious, which ordinary knowledge cannot comprehend. Who knows, perhaps Cao Ba's appearance will not be clear enough to promote the faith of the following people!

The Venerable asked: "What is the reason why the monks in Zen Buddhism often deny the Pure Land?".

Dharma Master Mo Lien: "The monks in Zen Buddhism only transmit the Buddha's mind. What the monks say is straight to reason. You have been meditating for many years but still do not understand that meaning. It is enough to see that your views are all evil views that destroy Zen Buddhism."

The Venerable said: "I don't dare to make it up myself, just because the words of the Patriarchs can be relied upon. Now let me tell you a few things:

The Sixth Patriarch said: Eastern people commit crimes to seek birth in the West. What world do Westerners commit crimes to seek rebirth in?

Trieu Chau said: I don't like to hear the word Buddha. And he said again: If an old monk recites Buddha's name for one hour, he should rinse his mouth for three days.

Why do monks in Zen Buddhism often say such things?

Mo Lien Dharma Master replied: The Sixth Patriarch pointed out the nature so that the other person could accept it from their own heart. He analyzed the words and argued about the practice, so he accepted the saddle of a donkey as a horse's saddle. Why are you so wrong?

You should know that people in the Pure Land are all free from negative thoughts and afflictions. They can progress through the dust and ignorance to attain the dharmakaya. Only by cultivating and cultivating will there be absolutely no sin. But now let's think about which world they will be born in?

People here in Saha who recite the Buddha's name, if they have not yet abandoned their thoughts and afflictions, will be reborn through the power of the Buddha's vow and will be reborn in the Pure Land of Mortals and Saints. Once born into the Pure Land, thoughts and afflictions will be completely destroyed, just like a bit of snow thrown into a red furnace and immediately melts. Thoughts that are purified will eventually be reborn in the Pure Land of Means and Residuals. Those who destroy ignorance will be born in the Real Realm of Unobstructed Dignified Pure Land. Ignorance is completely cleansed, blessings and wisdom are fulfilled and one is born in the Pure Land of Eternal Light.

Why do you worry so much about them not having a place to be born that you then shame yourself and prevent them from praying for birth? It's like someone who is too naive to hear that he will choke on rice, then is too scared to eat and then starves to death!

He reported that Venerable Trieu Chau said: I don't like to hear a word of Buddha. Why don't you recite the following sentence: Someone asked the Venerable whether he saves people? Trieu Chau replied: Buddha! Buddha!

He just wanted to grasp the saying: Whenever we recite the Buddha's name for one hour, then rinse our mouth for three days. But he forgot the part: Someone asked the Venerable what he would use to repay the king's offerings like that? Trieu Chau said: I recite Buddha's name! He forgot the part where someone asked: Do the Buddhas of the ten directions have teachers? Trieu Chau replied: Yes. Question: What is the teacher of the Buddhas? Trieu Chau replied: Amitabha Buddha! Amitabha Buddha!

He asked why Zen monks often say such things? You should know that when monks speak words to people, it is called Co Phong, or Transliteration. Ask in the place of answer, answer in the place of question. If a person who studies the Dharma does not know how to return the light and reflect from his own mind, but instead focuses on the meaning of words, then he is eating dirt, chasing after lumps of soil, and will never see his nature!

I have been a monk for more than thirty years, and I have always heard the words of the monks saying: I don't like to hear the word Buddha..., but the sentences USE BUDDHA'S REMEMBER TO SAVE PEOPLE, USE BUDDHA'S REMEMBER TO GIVE GRATITUDE TO THE KING, Amitabha Buddha IS THE TEACHER OF THE BUDDHA, rarely heard from the monks.

And all of the above sentences came from the mouth of Mr. Trieu Chau, if you believe then you must believe all of them, why contradict yourself by choosing what is harmful and abandoning what is beneficial.

In terms of Trieu Chau's words, it all comes down to his own part. The sentence of not liking to hear the word Buddha, as well as the sentence of reciting Buddha's name to repay gratitude, etc., are all transliterations. If the direct listener can see his own mind, he will know that Trieu Chau's Dharma is far beyond common sense, the Venerable's words are exceptional, he will be diligent in reciting Buddha's name all day long without stopping.

If you don't see or hear something like the above, then you should only rely on the Buddha's recitation and be cautious about refuting the Buddha. According to Buddha's name, one can escape from reincarnation in this life. If you follow Buddha, you will definitely fall into hell.

Those who follow harm but abandon benefit, is it because of their karma of overvaluing blessings and obscuring wisdom and wisdom? (If the listener does not understand and misunderstand, it is called harm and benefit, not the loss and benefit of the Patriarch's words.)

He again said that the words of the Patriarchs can be followed, so why don't you follow what Patriarch Bach Truong taught: PRACTICE IN REMEMBERING THE BUDDHA IS STABLE. The Patriarch's rule is that when the sick monks are cured and the dead monks are buried, they are all dedicated to praying for rebirth in the Pure Land.

The 14th Patriarch, Nagarjuna Bodhisattva attained the First Land of Rebirth in Ultimate Bliss. In the Patriarch's treatises, there are many places praising the Pure Land. As Bhikkhu Sa Luan praises the method of reciting Buddha's name to pray for rebirth as an easy path to reach quickly.

The Great Master Ma Minh, the 12th Patriarch, at the end of the Treatise on Faith teaches the most superior means, telling people to recite Buddha's name and seek rebirth in the West, often serving Amitabha Buddha to attain a state of non-regression (2).

First Patriarch Mahakasyapa and Second Patriarch Ananda compiled the Sutras on the Pure Land. If the Pure Land Sutras were not beneficial but harmful to people in the future, why would they blindly let them circulate!

In the Mahayana Sutras, the Pure Land is discussed and praised. As for the Hinayana scriptures, they are not mentioned at all. Do you want to believe in Hinayana while rejecting Mahayana?

When Shakyamuni Buddha preached the Amitabha Sutra, all the Buddhas in the six directions showed wide and long tongues advising sentient beings to believe. Are you planning to say that the Buddhas want to harm sentient beings?

If you think that with the Sixth Patriarch, Trieu Chau, etc., it is impossible not to believe, then with Kasyapa, Ananda, Ma Minh, Nagarjuna, Sakyamuni, Amitabha, and the Buddhas of the six directions, it is even more impossible not to believe. Seeing near but not seeing far, knowing small but not understanding big, is no different from the villagers who only admire the power of district and district officials, but do not know the dignity of the President and Emperor. Like a child who desires a bronze mirror but does not care for a wish-fulfilling jewel.

---o0o---

IV. MEDITATION DOES NOT GUARANTEE QUIET LIBERATION

tom_tat: Pausing for a second, Dharma Master Mo Lien continued: "Do you know that Zen Master Vinh Minh Dien Tho Tri Giac expounded four simple verses, which clearly show the benefits and losses of Zen and Tinh. Vinh Minh is an iconic Patriarch...
noi_dung:
V. CORRECT INTERPRETATION OF MATERIALS

Pausing for a second, Dharma Master Mo Lien continued: "Do you know that Zen Master Vinh Minh Dien Tho Tri Giac taught four simple verses, which clearly show the benefits and losses of Zen and Tinh. Vinh Minh is the Patriarch of Zen and Lien Tong, is there any reason to harm people?"

The Venerable said: "Is Vinh Minh's simplicity not enough for people to follow? Because it says that anyone who meditates has pure time like a tiger with horns, in this life he can become a master, in the future he will become a Buddha. It seems that nowadays people who practice meditation are asking: Who is that chanting the Buddha's name? There are people who spend years chanting the Buddha's name to recite the Buddha's name, can those people be a master in this life and become a Buddha in the next life?"

In the simple document, it is said: "Without meditation, there are ten people who practice ten times and are reborn. If they meet Amitabha Buddha, why worry about not being enlightened? It seems that at present, countless people recite the Buddha's name, but we have not seen a few people at the time of death who appear in teleportation signs thanks to the Buddha to lead them to rebirth in the Pure Land. Therefore, we know clearly that Patriarch Vinh Minh's simple document has no specific experience."

Master Mo Lien said: "Why did you so greedily swallow the apple without chewing and tasting the sweetness of the fruit?"

Studying carefully the simple words of Patriarch Vinh Minh, which is the outline of the Mahayana, the guide of the practice, you should first realize what Zen is Pure, what is Existence and Emptiness, and then consider the whole text, you will see that in that simple document, each word is as solid as heaven creating and earth. There is not a single word that is not correct, not a single word that can be changed. He quickly criticized the material in a vague and aimless manner. For decades now, I have seen that most Zen masters and lecturers have the same knowledge as you. No wonder Zen and Tinh are declining day by day!

The Venerable requested: "Please, Master, please explain clearly what is MEDITATION and PURITY and what is YES and NO."

Dharma Master Mo Lien said: "ZEN is our inherent Buddha-nature. Zen Buddhism calls it the original face before our parents were born, without saying it clearly, trying to let people self-study and realize it for themselves. In fact, it is: PURE MIND AND BODY, SPIRIT OF PERCEPTION AND MINDS WITHOUT ENERGY, WITHOUT POSSIBILITY, IMMEDIATE ACTIVITY.

PURITY is DEEP BELIEF, PRAYER, SPECIALIZED MIND, REMAINING THE FAME, PRAYING FOR SUCCESSFUL BIRTH. It is not the idealistic Pure Land, Amitabha's self-nature.

When the meditator has exhausted all of his thoughts, his delusions have stopped, his delusions have ended, he can clearly see his original face and clearly see his nature, that is called MEDITATION.

As for those who truly practice Pure Land, they develop the mind of Bodhi, believe deeply, and vow to diligently uphold the holy names to seek rebirth in the Western Land of Ultimate Bliss. That is called PURE.

MEDITATION and PEACE are the teachings. As for MEDITATION and PEACE, it depends on the practitioner. Regarding the teachings, time is eternal, Buddha cannot add, mortal cannot decrease. As for those who practice, they need to rely on the teachings to establish their conduct, and their conduct is extremely high and can be proven by reason. How can my place be truly real? These two things (PURE MEDITATION and PURE MEDITATION), although the text is similar, the meaning is very different. You must consider carefully, not be confused.

Or a person who meditates but is not yet enlightened, or who is enlightened but has not yet thoroughly understood it, is not called MEDITATION.

As for the person who recites the Buddha's name but is single-minded, does not have faith or vows, or has faith but does not have a deep faith, does not pray earnestly, does it purely for the sake of it, or even though he is diligent but his mind is attached to worldly desires, or prays to be rich in the next life or to be born in heaven, or prays to become a Sangha in the next life to propagate the Buddha Dharma for the benefit of all living beings, all of these cannot be called PURE.

The Venerable interrupted and asked: "What is wrong with becoming a monk and spreading the Dharma to benefit living beings and being expelled?".

Mo Lien Dharma Master replied: "If one has completely eliminated karma and afflictions, has escaped birth and death, and then relies on the great vow to have a body in the evil realm to save sentient beings.

On the contrary, if one has not yet attained liberation and is born in a depraved life, it is difficult to ensure freedom from delusion. Even though one can propagate the Dharma but one has not yet attained the fruition of No-birth, one is bound to be influenced by circumstances and one's predestined fates. It's very rare for people who are delusional to be lucky enough to be enlightened. Most of those who fall into delusion go deep into the world of delusion and are doomed to eternal damnation.

For this reason, our Master Shakyamuni advises all living beings of the present and the end of the dharma to pray for rebirth in the Pure Land so that they can see the Buddha and hear the Dharma, quickly attain the patience of No-birth, and then, depending on their wishes, enter Saha to save sentient beings. In this way, there is progress but no retreat, benefit but no loss.

The problem of not attaining the liberation of No-birth but remaining forever in Saha, other sects have room for it, but reciting the Buddha's name is completely banned. Many people think that meditating is Zen, reciting Buddha's name is Pure. That is not only not knowing Zen and Tinh, but also not knowing the meaning. So she betrayed Patriarch Vinh Minh's great compassion and obstructed the monk's shortcut to escape suffering. It's just the wrong direction of the map, a thousand miles wrong!".

V. CORRECT INTERPRETATION OF MATERIALS

The Venerable said: "I have asked you to explain the concept of MEDITATION and YES NO, please kindly explain the full text to me."

Dharma Master Mo Lien said: "In the first simple verse, the Patriarch said:

There is Zen and there is Pure Land

Just like a tiger grows horns

Present life as a teacher for others

In the next life, he will become a Buddha or Patriarch

This practitioner fully realizes the Zen sect's insight into the nature of the mind, that is, there is MEDITATION. Thoroughly understanding the Sutra Pitaka, understanding all the true martial arts methods, then choosing the Buddha Reciting Faith and Prayer discipline for oneself to practice and encourage others, that is PURENESS.

In the Sixteen Contemplation Sutras, it is said that the Supreme Being who reads and recites the Mahayana and understands the first meaning of encouraging practitioners is this person. This person has great wisdom and eloquent talent. The evil spirits of the pagans heard their reputation and were shocked. Like a tiger growing horns, what other animal dares to oppose it!

Anyone who comes to seek Dharma immediately follows the teachings. Those who are worthy of learning the Pure Land Zen subject but also practice should teach the Zen subject that includes Pure Land practice. Those who are worthy of studying the Pure Land subject must teach the Pure Land subject. Regardless of whether you are of superior ability or lower intelligence, once you come to seek enlightenment, you will immediately receive great benefits. Isn't that your current life as your teacher! At the time of his death, the Buddha took him to the highest level of rebirth. The flowers bloomed and saw the Buddha attaining No Birth. The highest level reached the Ten Bodhisattva Levels, the lowest level.

also at the Bodhisattva level of the first stage. The Bodhisattva of the first level can also manifest as a Buddha to save beings in one hundred worlds without Buddhas, let alone the above 40 Bodhisattvas. Isn't that the way to become a Buddha in the next life?

The second simple verse, the Patriarch said:

There is no Zen, only Pure Land

Thousands of people practice, thousands of people are reborn

When meeting Amitabha Buddha

Why worry about not being enlightened?

People who have not yet clearly understood their nature, but are determined to seek rebirth in the Western Land of Ultimate Bliss, those who diligently cultivate concentration and wisdom will certainly be reborn. Even those who have committed evil throughout their lives, when they are about to die, have a very remorseful and shameful mind, earnestly and earnestly, calling themselves Namo Amitabha Buddha. Even if they only last ten hours, they will die, thanks to the power of the Buddha's wish, they will be reborn in the Pure Land. As the chapter Nine Levels of Rebirth in the Buddha's Infinite Life Sutra clearly stated. Isn't that the case of thousands of people cultivating and all of them being reborn? But here we should further acknowledge that: Amitabha Buddha made a great vow to accept all sentient beings and recite Buddha's name as earnestly and sincerely as a child misses his mother, and feels the same way as the Buddha. If you don't discuss Buddha's thoughts for a long time, you will be saved. One should not compare Buddha's name with carelessness. After being reborn in the Pure Land, even though seeing the Buddha and hearing the Dharma come early or late, they all share the same Saintly stream, sooner or later they attain the same Sainthood. Having attained Sainthood, there is no need to discuss the issue of enlightenment. That is when you meet Amitabha Buddha, why worry about not being enlightened!

In the third simple verse, the Patriarch said:

There is Zen but not Pure Land

Nine out of ten people hesitated

When it's time to warm up, the scene appears

Blink your eyes and follow it.

Although this person fully understands the Zen sect's enlightened mind and sees the nature, the negative thoughts and afflictions are not easily eliminated. They must go through a lot of practice and practice to cleanse them completely in order to escape the cycle of birth and death. If there is still a part of affliction left, then the six paths of reincarnation will still be the same, let alone the person who has not been able to cut off any part!

The ocean of birth and death is wide and deep, the path to Bodhi is far away, and before you can return home, the god of death has come. Ten people will suddenly realize nine people like that. That's nine out of ten people who hesitated.

The word TA in the original text is TA DA, commonly known as hesitation. As for the WARM, it is the INTERMEDIATE BODY, at the moment of death, the good or bad scenes that have been created in this life or in previous lives appear sequentially, in the blink of an eye, they immediately follow whichever scene is strongest, causing them to be born without control. Quy Son said: Like a debtor, the owner pulls hard first, but the mind has many heavy concerns and falls apart. The example of Gioi To and Thao Duong should be known.

Some people believe that the word "TA" is MAM, and "AM" is the "FIVE WARDINGS". It's because we don't understand the meaning of the words MEDITATION and the word YES that we interpret them so wrongly. There will never be a great enlightened person, but out of ten people, out of ten, nine will lose their way and follow the five skandhas and be relied on by the demons. They are all arrogant monks who do not understand the teachings and do not realize their own mind, who practice blindly and practice blindly, and are harmed. Why do you bring the bait to the great enlightenment? This issue is very important and should not be left unexplained.

In the fourth verse, the Patriarch said:

Without Zen, there is no Purity

Hot iron bed with copper pillars

Through eons and thousands of lives

Can't rely on anyone.

Some people mistakenly think that: without Zen, without Purity, they are those who bury their heads in creating bad karma and do not practice good deeds. Such an understanding is very wrong!

You should know that Buddha's teachings are immeasurable, only Zen and Pure Land are correct

most. A person who practices without having complete enlightenment is not Zen, and also does not have faith in reciting Buddha's name and is not Pure. If you have not determined to practice wisdom and attain enlightenment, you will not be able to rely on the power of the Buddha's vow to receive rebirth. In the present life of practice, there is merit and virtue, and one can feel the blessings of humanity and heaven in the next life. If one has not attained Holy Wisdom, one will be turned around by good karma and will become infatuated with the worldly world of sensual pleasures and commit many crimes. Having committed a crime, it will be difficult to escape the evil consequences of hell in the next life, the whole life must suffer on a hot iron bed, next to a red copper pillar to pay for the sin of lust and harming animals. Although Buddhas and Bodhisattvas are always merciful, they cannot be saved because of their evil karma, so the verse says that for all eternity, one cannot rely on anyone.

The ancients said: Anyone who practices without righteous faith to seek rebirth in the Pure Land and practice other good dharmas is called a third-generation unjust family, which is exactly the same idea as this verse. Because in this life you practice and enjoy blessings in the next life, then rely on the power of blessings to create bad karma, and in the next life you will fall into hell. Enjoy temporary blessings in the next life but many lifetimes of suffering in the future. Even if you are satisfied with hell, you still have to go through ghosts and beasts. Who knows, maybe we won't create more bad karma and fall down again. Hoping to escape the Three Paths and attain a human body is one of the most difficult things

The Buddha once dipped his finger in the ground and then asked Venerable Ananda if the soil on his hand was much or the earth's soil was much? Ananda white lands of the earth are many. The Buddha immediately said: Gaining a human body is like the soil stuck to your hands, but losing a human body is like the soil of the entire earth.

According to the Buddha's comparison of proportions, the Patriarch's words for thousands of generations are still close arguments, because the story is written in verse.

In terms of other methods that specialize in self-reliance, while the method of reciting Buddha's name to seek rebirth, it specializes in relying on Buddha's power. When other disciplines are free from all afflictions, they can escape birth and death, while the Pure Land discipline, when reborn with karma, immediately becomes a Saint.

Patriarch Vinh Minh was afraid that people would not receive the vast benefits of the method of reciting the Buddha's rebirth, so he specially created simple verses to teach. It is worthy to call the simple verse a treasure boat in a land of delusion, a Teacher in a dangerous path. It's a pity that people just read it and don't study it carefully. Is it possible that sentient beings share the same evil karma that it causes them to do?

Brief history of GREAT MASTER NGUYEN CHIEN

(Excerpt from the second volume The Road to Bliss)

Great Master Nguon Chieu is from Tram Nhien, has the Duong family, and is from Du Hang. At first, he specialized in studying law with Lawyer Hue Giam, then followed Zen Master Than Chieu to listen to lectures on the Thien Thai Teachings. When he received the Bodhisattva precepts from Dharma Master Quang Tu, the light of precepts illuminated the entire precept platform. Feeling that inspiration, he specialized in studying the Vinaya Pitaka, holding an alms bowl at the market.

Later, he stayed at Linh Chi Pagoda for thirty years and ordained monks in more than sixty meetings. Every day, he concentrated on the Pure Land. He often said: "When I live, I propagate the precepts; when I die, I return to the Pure Land; that is my possession." He composed the Pure Land Repentance Ritual and wrote the preface: "Since coming to the precepts, I have been dedicated to studying the Law. Next, I met Thien Thai Than Ngo Chu Khiem, a Dharma Master who wholeheartedly and diligently studied Buddhism. And because of that, I made a vow: Always be born in the Saha world of the five defilements and evils to be a great teacher to guide living beings to the Buddhist path."

I read the story of Cao Tang and saw Dharma Master Hue Bo saying: Even though Pure Bliss is pure, it is not my place of prayer. Suppose you enjoy the joy of living in the lotus flower for twelve lifetimes, how can it be better than being in the three paths of saving sentient beings? " Therefore, I firmly grasped my old ambition, and for many years I had no concept of turning to the Pure Land, and also despised people who cultivate pure karma. One year I was seriously ill, my body was weak, my mind was confused. At that time, I had no intention. If I died, I would not know where to go. After my illness healed, I immediately realized that my previous concept was a mistake: because my aspiration was great, but I don't have enough ability. Sad and crying, I blame myself.

I opened the volume of the Ten Commentaries and saw that it said that the Bodhisattva's initial mind has not yet attained the patience of Non-birth and cannot leave the Buddha.

In it, Tri Do Luan is quoted: "If you have a heart of great compassion and wish to be born in the evil and impure world to save suffering sentient beings, you should not! For example, children should not be far from their parents, young birds should only pass on branches." From then on, I threw away all my previous studies and specialized in reading the Sutras and treatises on the Pure Land, and for nearly twenty years I never took a break. I thoroughly researched the teachings, reviewing both ancient and modern times. Doubtful notions about the Pure Land disappear like dew; My faith in the Pure Land is growing deeper and stronger. I again saw the commentary on the two subjects "specialized practice" and "mixed practice" by the Venerable Thien Dao: "If you practice professionally, a hundred people will practice and a hundred people will be reborn; if you practice mixed practice, it will be difficult for thousands of people to get one or two."

I consider that my mind is scattered and contemplation is difficult to achieve, so I only focus on reciting the four words of the holy name. For many generations, I left my father and ran away, but now I feel like I know how to come home. I use the place where I practice to advise everyone to practice. The wonderful Dharma door is achieved through faith. Like Mahasthamaprapta, by reciting the Buddha's name with his mind, he attained enlightenment and entered the Samadhi realm. I pondered again: I did not believe in the Pure Land in the past, destroyed the Dharma, despised people, and created countless karma. In my heart, I was filled with shame and fear morning and night. Before the Buddha's platform, I revealed my heart and my five-dimensional figure earnestly repented.

Then I made a vow: "All sentient beings who practice Buddha's name will be reborn in Ultimate Bliss."

If you want to practice regularly, you must establish a ritual of practice, so I compiled the writings of my predecessors to repent this dharma. From beginning to end, twelve subjects are presented. Everything here is according to the Buddha's words and the Patriarch's will. The next person who reads it will understand my intention.

In addition, he composed the Commentary on the Meaning of the Contemplation Sutra and the Commentary on Amitabha Buddha's Meaning. As for his stories, there are more than two hundred volumes in total.

In the sixth year of Chan Hoa, in the fall, he told the monks to recite the Sutra and the Samantabhadra Vow. He sat cross-legged, quietly listening, then peacefully passed away. At that time, everyone heard the sound of heavenly music throughout the void...

EXTRACTS OF THE SUTRAS ABOUT THE WESTERN PURE LAND IN THE GREAT Tripitaka

After 50 years of preaching, the Original Master Shakyamuni Buddha taught ten thousand Dharma methods. Among them, there is only the Western Pure Land dharma that the Original Master has taught the most many times and most thoroughly. Looking at this, it is enough to see that this method is very suitable and very beneficial for everyone. Below I will sequentially introduce the Sutras teaching about this method that I have read, and at the same time summarize a few essential passages in them, to help add more research material and confidence to my fellow practitioners. In addition, I believe that there are many Sutras teaching about this method that I have not read yet. I hope it will be supplemented at the advanced level.

---o0o---

1.- THE GREAT Amitabha Sutra

Originally the same Sanskrit text, translated into five Chinese texts:

A - Immeasurable Equality Pure Enlightenment Sutra

B - Infinite Life Sutra

C - Amitabha Sutra

D - Infinite Life Solemn Sutra

E - Precious Accumulation of the Infinite Life Tathagata Assembly

Shakyamuni Buddha lived in Rajagaha City, Vulture Mountain, for the sake of Maitreya Bodhisattva and Ananda Venerable Ananda, speaking about the original vows and karma of Amitabha Buddha, the Teacher of the Western Land of Ultimate Bliss. (From the Dharma Pitaka, the Bhikkhu made 48 great vows, practiced countless lives, etc. until he became Buddha in the Land of Ultimate Bliss).

---o0o---

2.- BUDDHIST SUTRA OF Immeasurable Life

Shakyamuni Buddha stayed at Rajagrha City, Ky Xa Quat Mountain, for Queen Mother Vi De Hi, and preached about the Pure Land and Amitabha Buddha. At the same time, he clearly teaches sixteen methods of contemplation. (From the dharma contemplation of the setting sun to the nine levels of rebirth. Here the scene of Ultimate Bliss and the bodies of Amitabha Buddha, Avalokiteshvara, and Theravada Buddha are described very clearly).

---o0o---

The Buddha at Ky Hoan Monastery in Xa Ve country called on Sariputta to talk about Amitabha Buddha and described the solemn and pure scene of the Pure Land world and advised everyone to believe in reciting the Buddha's name and pray for rebirth. There are Buddhas from all directions speaking together to prove and advise sentient beings to believe.

(The three Sutras above explain the Western Pure Land most clearly and completely. If you want to understand, please see the original source).

Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva said to Shakyamuni Buddha: I remember countless past lives, when Buddha Infinite Light was born... then Buddha Infinite Light was born. 12 Buddhas were born in one lifetime. 10.- BUU Tich Sutra

The Master said to his Father (Tinh Phan King): "All sentient beings are Buddhas. You should recite the Western world Amitabha Buddha and be diligent and diligent and you will become a Buddha." The king asked: "How can all sentient beings be Buddhas?". The Master preached: "All are determined to be without birth, unshakable, unattached, without appearance, without self-nature. The Buddha smiled and spoke verses:

They like to be decisive

That's why it's in Buddhism

Decide to believe, your mind stays calm

After leaving this human body

Being born in the Land of Peace (Ultimate Bliss)

Close to Amitabha Buddha

Achieve fearlessness and attain Bodhi.

11.- BUU Tich Sutra

Buddha Shakyamuni told Bodhisattva Maitreya to practice ten things and be reborn in the Pure Land:

1) In living beings, there is great compassion, not oppression.

2) In living beings, there is great compassion and no harm.

3) Having the mind to protect the Buddha Dharma, not sparing one's life or life.

4) Have a mind of patience and non-attachment towards all dharmas.

5) Have a pure mind of mockery, not greed for gain, cultivate respect and respect.

6) Have a mind that always prays for Buddha's wisdom and never forgets it.

7) Have a mind that respects living beings and does not despise them.

8) Have a determined mind in the Bodhi part, not be fooled by worldly arguments.

9) Cultivate good roots with a pure mind without impurities.

10) Start reciting Buddha's name and stay away from appearances.

Above is called the Bodhisattva who develops ten things in his mind. Because of this mind, one will be reborn. If among those ten minds, no matter which one of them is accomplished, they wish to be reborn in the Pure Land of Amitabha Buddha, then they will definitely be born.

---o0o---

---o0o---

Manjushri Bodhisattva told himself that if he recites the Buddha's name in Samadhi, he will be born in the Pure Land. Buddha Shakyamuni predicted that: He will be reborn in the Pure Land.

---o0o---

Buddha Shakyamuni told the Dharma Assembly: Those who seek Supreme Bodhi should practice reciting the Buddha's name and meditate in Samadhi... Then the Buddha spoke verses:

If a person claims to recite Amitabha Buddha's name

At the moment of concentration, imagine seeing the Buddha

Shakyamuni Buddha told Manjushri Bodhisattva: If you want to quickly achieve Supreme Bodhi, you must practice Samadhi.
